Authors: Junhoo Lee, Seungyeon Kim, Baekseung Kim, Minkyu Kim, Suhyun Jeon, Jimyeong Kim, Nojun Kwak

F2A-ObjectNav: An Adaptive Agentic Architecture for Object-Goal Navigation VLN

object-goal navigation adaptive agentic architecture embodied agent AI2-THOR semantic guidance

简要说明：本文提出了F2A-ObjectNav，一种用于目标导航的自适应智能体架构，通过规则监督器协调专用组件，在多个具身环境中取得了较高的成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces F2A-ObjectNav, an adaptive agentic architecture for object-goal navigation that coordinates a rule-based supervisor with specialized components, achieving strong success rates across multiple embodied environments (AI2-THOR, RoboTHOR, ProcTHOR).

Abstract: Object-goal navigation requires an embodied agent to explore an unfamiliar environment, identify a target object, navigate toward candidate instances, and reliably determine whether the observed object satisfies the mission goal. This work investigates this problem through a two-stage development process. In Stage I, a fixed modular framework is used to examine combinations of exploration, object detection, and target validation methods. The results reveal clear trade-offs among navigation performance, validation reliability, execution time, and model-related cost, with no single fixed configuration remaining preferable across all evaluated conditions. These observations motivate F2A-ObjectNav (Fixed-to-Adaptive Object-Goal Navigation), an adaptive agentic architecture in which a rule-based Supervisor coordinates specialized components for navigation and exploration, object detection, target validation, semantic guidance, and Mission Memory. The architecture uses event-driven recovery, strategy revision, candidate management, and conditional semantic guidance while retaining lightweight execution during normal operation. F2A-ObjectNav is evaluated over 25 episodes in each of AI2-THOR, RoboTHOR, and ProcTHOR, achieving success rate (SR) / success-weighted path length (SPL) values of 0.84/0.52, 0.40/0.22, and 0.44/0.37, respectively. In addition to task-level metrics, architecture-specific behavioral metrics are used to characterize semantic-guidance usage, strategy switching, recovery activation, memory-supported behavior, and decision stability. The results show different patterns of adaptive intervention across the three environments, with higher intervention frequencies observed in RoboTHOR and ProcTHOR than in AI2-THOR.

摘要（中文）：目标导向导航要求具身智能体在陌生环境中进行探索，识别目标物体，导航至候选实例，并可靠地判断所观察到的物体是否满足任务目标。本研究通过两阶段开发流程对该问题进行探讨。在阶段一中，采用固定的模块化框架，考察探索、物体检测与目标验证方法的组合效果。实验结果表明，导航性能、验证可靠性、执行时间与模型相关成本之间存在明显的权衡关系，在所有评估条件下，没有任何一种固定配置始终占优。这些观察促使我们提出F2A-ObjectNav（固定到自适应目标导向导航）——一种自适应智能体架构，其中基于规则的监督器协调导航与探索、物体检测、目标验证、语义引导和任务记忆等专用组件。该架构采用事件驱动的恢复机制、策略修正、候选管理及条件性语义引导，同时在正常运行期间保持轻量级执行。F2A-ObjectNav在AI2-THOR、RoboTHOR和ProcTHOR中各25个情节上进行评估，分别取得了成功率（SR）/成功率加权路径长度（SPL）为0.84/0.52、0.40/0.22和0.44/0.37的结果。除任务级指标外，还使用架构特定的行为指标来刻画语义引导使用、策略切换、恢复激活、记忆支持行为及决策稳定性。结果表明，三种环境中的自适应干预模式各不相同，RoboTHOR和ProcTHOR中的干预频率高于AI2-THOR。

Authors: Seyed Ali Mirghasemi, Alireza Taheri

PolyMorph: Learning Locomotion Policy for Cross-Embodiment Adaptation Locomotion

morphology-conditioned reinforcement learning legged locomotion graph-based Transformer cross-embodiment

简要说明：PolyMorph 提出了一种基于形态条件的强化学习框架，通过循环编码器、图Transformer和逐关节解码器，训练单一运动策略以适配不同形态的腿式机器人，并在真实四足平台上成功部署。

TLDR: PolyMorph presents a morphology-conditioned reinforcement learning framework that trains a single locomotion policy for heterogeneous legged robots, using a recurrent encoder, graph-based Transformer, and per-joint decoder to handle variable leg counts and joints, successfully deployed on real quadruped platforms.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has enabled robust locomotion for legged robots, but learned policies are typically tied to a specific robot morphology and require additional engineering when the number of legs, actuators, or mechanical properties change. We present PolyMorph, a morphology-conditioned framework that learns a single locomotion policy for heterogeneous legged robots. PolyMorph converts each robot's URDF into joint-link modules and combines a recurrent encoder, graph-based Transformer, and per-joint decoder to generate actions across variable leg counts and joint configurations. To improve training stability, PolyMorph uses morphology-normalized rewards, adaptive robot sampling, and URDF-derived PD-gain initialization. We evaluate PolyMorph in simulation across bipedal, tripedal, and quadrupedal robots, including unseen morphology variants and platforms, and deploy the policy on real quadruped platforms operated in multiple configurations. The results show that a single PolyMorph policy generalizes across diverse robot morphologies without per-robot policy retraining.

摘要（中文）：强化学习已使腿式机器人实现了稳健的 locomotion，但学习到的策略通常与特定机器人形态绑定，当腿的数量、执行器或机械属性发生变化时，需要额外的工程设计。我们提出了 PolyMorph，一种形态条件化框架，可针对异质腿式机器人学习单一 locomotion 策略。PolyMorph 将每个机器人的 URDF 转换为关节-连杆模块，并结合循环编码器、基于图的 Transformer 和逐关节解码器，在可变腿部数量和关节配置下生成动作。为提高训练稳定性，PolyMorph 采用形态归一化奖励、自适应机器人采样以及从 URDF 推导的 PD 增益初始化。我们在双足、三足和四足机器人的仿真中评估了 PolyMorph，包括未见过的形态变体和平台，并在多种配置下运行的真实四足平台上部署了该策略。结果表明，单一 PolyMorph 策略能泛化到多种机器人形态，而无需针对每个机器人重新训练策略。

Authors: Hyunsik Oh, Seunghun Jeon, Donghoon Youm, Jungwoo Hur, Hyeongjun Kim, Jeong Hyun Lee, Moonkyu Jung, Jemin Hwangbo

Cracking Mobile Manipulation: From Failure Diagnosis to Agentic Robot System VLA

failure diagnosis mobile manipulation agentic intervention subtask VLA long-horizon

简要说明：本文诊断了子任务VLA性能与长时程移动操作成功之间的差距，识别出规划、导航和局部操作瓶颈，并提出一种失败引导的智能体系统，在RoboCasa365、BEHAVIOR-1K和真实机器人上显著提高了任务成功率。

TLDR: This paper diagnoses the gap between subtask VLA performance and long-horizon mobile manipulation success, identifying planning, navigation, and local manipulation bottlenecks, and proposes a failure-guided agentic system that significantly improves task success across RoboCasa365, BEHAVIOR-1K, and real robots.

Abstract: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong performance on local robot manipulation, yet their success does not readily translate to long-horizon mobile manipulation. In our experiments, a pretrained subtask VLA achieves 80% success rate on atomic manipulation tasks but only 19% when these skills are composed into mobile manipulation. We argue that this gap stems from failures across the execution process rather than from local manipulation capability alone. To uncover these bottlenecks, we systematically diagnose failures in long-horizon mobile manipulation and identify three dominant regimes: task planning, navigation and base positioning, and local manipulation. Based on this diagnosis, we develop failure-guided agentic intervention that augments a fixed subtask VLA with demonstration-based planning guidance, adaptive visual memory, accessibility-aware base adjustment, and local end-effector adjustment. On RoboCasa365, these interventions progressively improve task success from 19% to 47%, with the finalized system reaching 49% on held-out episode seeds, compared with 18% for the baseline. The same design improves performance from 14% to 37% on BEHAVIOR-1K and from 5/20 to 13/20 on real-robot tasks. These results suggest that reliable mobile manipulation can be advanced by diagnosing and intervening on the current bottleneck, rather than uniformly scaling the underlying policy. Our code will be released at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/Cracking-Mobile-Manipulation.git.

摘要（中文）：近期视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在局部机器人操作任务中表现优异，但其成功经验并不能直接迁移至长时程移动操作任务。在我们的实验中，一个预训练的子任务VLA模型在原子操作任务上达到了80%的成功率，然而当这些技能组合为移动操作任务时，成功率骤降至19%。我们认为，这一差距主要源于整个执行过程中的各类失败，而不仅仅是局部操作能力的问题。为揭示这些瓶颈，我们对长时程移动操作中的失败进行了系统性诊断，识别出三个主要问题环节：任务规划、导航与基座定位、以及局部操作。基于该诊断结果，我们开发了失败引导的智能体干预方法，该方法在固定子任务VLA模型基础上，引入基于示范的规划引导、自适应视觉记忆、可达性感知的基座调整以及局部末端执行器调整。在RoboCasa365基准上，这些干预措施将任务成功率从19%逐步提升至47%，最终系统在预留的测试场景种子中达到49%的成功率，而基线方法仅为18%。相同的设计在BEHAVIOR-1K基准上将成功率从14%提升至37%，在真实机器人任务中从5/20提升至13/20。上述结果表明，通过对当前瓶颈进行诊断与针对性干预，而非一味扩大底层策略规模，能够有效推动移动操作可靠性的提升。我们的代码将发布于 https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/Cracking-Mobile-Manipulation.git。

Authors: Zixuan Wang, Jia-Ning Li, Yinzhou Tang, Yanzhao Yu, Biao Wu, Meng Fang, Xin Li, Yiwu Zhong

RoboSpan: Learning Modular Coordination Policies for High-DoF Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation with Teleoperation Manipulation

Hierarchical Modular Framework mobile manipulation teleoperation vision-language model whole-body control

简要说明：RoboSpan 提出了一个遥操作平台和分层模块化框架，用于在 29 自由度机器人上学习全身移动操作策略，利用 VLM 驱动的任务分解和跨模块注意力来提高长时程接触丰富任务的成功率。

TLDR: RoboSpan introduces a teleoperation platform and a Hierarchical Modular Framework for learning whole-body mobile manipulation policies on a 29-DoF robot, using VLM-driven task decomposition and cross-module attention to improve long-horizon contact-rich task success.

Abstract: Whole-body mobile manipulation suffers from two fundamental challenges: inherent motion heterogeneity across locomotion, arm, and hand modules, and progressive error accumulation over long-horizon multi-stage tasks. Existing teleoperation platforms also lack integrated dexterous tactile sensing to support coordinated whole-body decision-making. This paper presents RoboSpan, a high-DoF whole-body teleoperation and demonstration platform, and the Hierarchical Modular Framework (HMF) for learning modular coordination policies. HMF functionally decouples the 29-DoF action space into fine hand manipulation, arm pose adjustment, and mobile-base spatial configuration branches, and introduces the Coordinated Modular Embodied Transformer (COMET) with inter-modular cross-attention to enable dynamic information exchange and action coordination. Vision-language model driven hierarchical task decomposition structurally suppresses temporal error propagation, while a full-palm 2D tactile representation encodes distributed contact signals for cross-module tactile empowerment. Experiments on a physical 29-DoF robot demonstrate that the proposed method achieves over 20\% higher task success rate than mainstream baselines across a range of long-horizon whole-body tasks, markedly improving stability and robustness in contact-rich manipulation.

摘要（中文）：全身移动操控面临两个基本挑战： locomotion、机械臂和手部模块之间固有的运动异构性，以及长时程多阶段任务中逐步累积的误差。现有遥操作平台也缺乏集成的灵巧触觉感知能力，以支持全身协调决策。本文提出了RoboSpan，一个高自由度全身遥操作与示范平台，以及用于学习模块化协调策略的分层模块化框架（HMF）。HMF将29自由度的动作空间功能性地解耦为精细手部操控、手臂姿态调整和移动基座空间配置三个分支，并引入了配备模块间交叉注意力的协调模块化具身Transformer（COMET），以实现动态信息交换和动作协调。基于视觉语言模型的分层任务分解从结构上抑制了时间误差传播，同时全手掌二维触觉表示编码分布式接触信号，实现跨模块触觉增强。在物理29自由度机器人上的实验表明，所提方法在一系列长时程全身任务中的任务成功率比主流基线高出20%以上，显著提升了接触丰富操控中的稳定性和鲁棒性。

Authors: Keqiang Ren, Xuecheng Ye, Hanyu Liu, Zhihua Wang, Tao Jian, Yunsheng Ma, Jiayi Wen, Xinran Li, Zhigong Song

Back on Track: Deployment-time Policy Improvement via World Model Planning VLA

deployment-time policy improvement world model planning liveness value monitoring-and-intervention visuomotor policies

简要说明：本文提出了一种部署时的监控与干预框架，利用学习的活性值和潜在世界模型来改进黑盒视觉运动策略（如VLA模型和扩散策略）在执行过程中的性能，而无需重新训练。

TLDR: This paper proposes a deployment-time monitoring-and-intervention framework that uses a learned liveness value and a latent world model to improve the performance of black-box visuomotor policies, such as VLA models and diffusion policies, during execution without retraining.

Abstract: State-of-the-art visuomotor policies are increasingly capable of executing complex tasks, yet can fail during deployment in ways they cannot predict or recover from on their own. Improving their performance and robustness typically requires collecting more data, retraining, or modifying the policy architecture, all of which are time- and resource-intensive in practice. We instead propose an offline-trained monitoring-and-intervention framework that improves a policy during deployment using only black-box query access. From a limited set of labeled on-policy rollouts, we learn a policy-conditioned liveness value that measures the nominal policy's progress toward task completion; we additionally train a compact latent world model using these rollouts together with play data. At deployment, the liveness value continuously monitors execution. When it detects a loss of progress, a short-horizon planner searches the world model for corrective actions using the same value as its planning objective, after which control returns to the nominal policy. We evaluate our method on the LIBERO-Goal task suite and on a Franka Panda manipulator, using the vision-language-action model $π_{0.5}$ and a diffusion policy as nominal policies, and demonstrate significant improvements in task success rates, while supporting real-time control. Additional results and videos are available on the project website (https://policy-improvement-wm.pages.dev/).

摘要（中文）：最新的视觉运动策略日益能够执行复杂任务，但在部署过程中仍可能以自身无法预测或自行恢复的方式失败。提升其性能与鲁棒性通常需要收集更多数据、重新训练或修改策略架构，而这些在实践中均耗时耗力。为此，我们提出一种离线训练式的监控与干预框架，仅需黑盒查询访问即可在部署阶段改进策略性能。利用少量带标注的在线策略轨迹，我们学习一个策略条件化的活性值（liveness value），用于衡量名义策略在任务完成过程中的进展；同时，我们利用这些轨迹及游戏数据训练一个紧凑的潜在世界模型。在部署时，活性值持续监控执行过程。当检测到进展损失时，一个短时域规划器以该活性值作为规划目标，在世界模型中搜索纠正动作，随后控制权交还回名义策略。我们在LIBERO-Goal任务套件及Franka Panda机械臂上，以视觉-语言-动作模型π_{0.5}和扩散策略作为名义策略评估了所提方法，结果显示任务成功率显著提升，同时支持实时控制。更多结果与视频参见项目网站（https://policy-improvement-wm.pages.dev/）。

Authors: Colton Crosby, Hao Wang, Mac Schwager, Somil Bansal

HiFun: a Hierarchical Framework for Efficient Functional Dexterous Manipulation Learning Manipulation

hierarchical RL dexterous manipulation real-world learning DMP augmentation reactive recovery

简要说明：HiFun提出了一种用于功能性灵巧操作的分层真实世界强化学习框架，将控制分解为手部技能策略和手臂-手协调策略，以实现高效学习和反应性恢复。在六个真实世界任务中，仅需一小时的在线训练即可达到98.3%的平均成功率。

TLDR: HiFun introduces a hierarchical real-world RL framework for functional dexterous manipulation, decoupling control into a hand skill policy and an arm-hand coordination policy to enable efficient learning and reactive recovery. It achieves 98.3% average success across six real-world tasks within one hour of online training.

Abstract: While multi-fingered dexterous robot hands have the potential to provide human-level dexterity, using them for functional manipulation remains difficult because task success depends on precise contact, coordinated arm-hand motion, and reactive recovery from execution errors. Precise contact depends on complex contact dynamics that are difficult to model accurately in simulation, motivating real-world learning. However, real-world demonstrations in the full arm-hand control space are costly and noisy because each trajectory must coordinate arm motion with high-DoF multi-finger contact. Small execution deviations can further cause slipped contact or premature force application, making recovery from off-nominal contact states important for robust execution. To deal with these challenges, we propose HiFun, a hierarchical real-world RL framework for functional dexterous manipulation tasks. Our key insight is to decouple the control complexity into a functional hand skill for precise contact execution and an arm-hand coordination policy for arm control and hand-skill activation. This design enables effective real-time human intervention for reactive recovery learning and efficient data collection with Dynamic Movement Primitive (DMP) augmentation. Across six real-world tasks on two dexterous hands, HiFun achieves 98.3% average success within one hour of online training and remains robust to dynamic disturbances. The project page is available at https://hly-123.github.io/HiFun/.

摘要（中文）：尽管多指灵巧机器人手具有提供人类级灵巧性的潜力，但将其用于功能性操作仍然困难，因为任务成功依赖于精确接触、协调的臂手运动以及对执行错误的反应性恢复。精确接触依赖于复杂的接触动力学，而这些动力学难以在仿真中精确建模，这推动了现实世界学习的需求。然而，在完整的臂手控制空间中进行现实世界演示成本高昂且噪声大，因为每条轨迹都必须将手臂运动与高自由度多指接触相协调。小的执行偏差还可能引发接触滑动或过早施力，因此，对非名义接触状态的恢复对于稳健执行至关重要。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了HiFun，一种用于功能性灵巧操作任务的分层现实世界强化学习框架。我们的关键洞察在于将控制复杂性解耦为负责精确接触执行的功能性手部技能，以及负责手臂控制和手部技能激活的臂手协调策略。这一设计使得有效的实时人为干预以进行反应性恢复学习，以及借助动态运动基元（DMP）增强的高效数据收集成为可能。在两个灵巧手执行的六个现实世界任务中，HiFun在一小时的在线训练内实现了98.3%的平均成功率，并且对动态干扰保持稳健。项目页面可在 https://hly-123.github.io/HiFun/ 查看。

Authors: Linyi Huang, Guowei Huai, Weibin Liu, Shulong Jiang, Ping Tan, Weixuan Zhang, Hui Zhang, Jie Song

Active Generative Simulation: Meta-Learning What to Simulate for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training Manipulation

sim-and-real co-training meta-learning data-generation distribution manipulation robot learning

简要说明：本文提出MetaGenSim，一种用于主动生成式仿真的元学习框架，通过优化仿真器的数据生成分布来最大化下游真实世界机器人策略的性能，在仿真和真实世界操作任务中均优于均匀生成和检索基线。

TLDR: This paper introduces MetaGenSim, a meta-learning framework for active generative simulation that optimizes the simulator's data-generation distribution to maximize downstream real-world robot policy performance, outperforming uniform generation and retrieval baselines in simulation and real-world manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Sim-and-real co-training is an effective way to scale robot learning by augmenting limited real-world demonstrations with simulation data. However, existing approaches typically treat simulators as fixed data sources, relying on uniform generation, offline retrieval, or manual parameter alignment by domain experts. We formulate \textit{Active Generative Simulation}: optimizing a simulator's data-generation distribution to maximize downstream real-world performance. To solve this problem, we propose MetaGenSim, a meta-learning framework that trains an auxiliary rater network via meta-gradients to automatically discover high-utility data-generation distributions within a user-specified simulation parameter space, without manual parameter alignment. Across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, MetaGenSim outperforms uniform generation and retrieval baselines, achieves a 150% relative improvement in real-world full-task success over uniform generation, and matches expert manual alignment. We further show that distributions curated with a lightweight proxy policy transfer to VLA fine-tuning, and that MetaGenSim can exploit partial alignment through atomic skill stitching and object-receptacle composition when exact sim-and-real task alignment is unavailable. Project website: https://meta-gensim.github.io

摘要（中文）：模拟与真实联合训练是一种通过利用仿真数据扩充有限的真实世界演示来扩展机器人学习的有效方法。然而，现有方法通常将仿真器视为固定数据源，依赖于统一生成、离线检索或由领域专家进行手动参数对齐。我们提出了**主动生成式仿真**这一概念：优化仿真器的数据生成分布，以最大化下游真实世界任务性能。为解决该问题，我们提出了MetaGenSim——一个元学习框架，通过元梯度训练辅助评分器网络，在用户指定的仿真参数空间内自动发现高效用数据生成分布，而无需手动参数对齐。在仿真和真实世界操作任务中，MetaGenSim优于统一生成和检索基线，在真实世界完整任务成功率上相较统一生成实现了150%的相对提升，并达到与专家手动对齐相当的性能。我们进一步表明，使用轻量级代理策略筛选出的数据分布可迁移至VLA微调，并且当仿真与真实任务无法精确对齐时，MetaGenSim能够通过原子技能拼接和物体-容器组合利用部分对齐。项目网站：https://meta-gensim.github.io

Authors: Liqian Ma, Vaibhav Saxena, Utkarsh Aashu Mishra, Shuo Cheng, Yongxin Chen, Danfei Xu

Paraphrase Consensus Is Not Self-Consistency: Instruction Reliance and Robustness in VLA Policies VLA

VLA policies instruction paraphrasing prompt ensembling LoRA post-training LIBERO benchmark

简要说明：本文研究了VLA策略对指令改写（paraphrase）的脆弱性，表明释义共识（paraphrase consensus）无法恢复显著的性能下降，并提出在释义指令上使用LoRA后训练作为有效的缓解方法。

TLDR: This paper investigates the fragility of VLA policies to instruction paraphrasing, showing that paraphrase consensus does not recover the substantial performance drop, and proposes LoRA post-training on paraphrased instructions as an effective mitigation.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies fine-tuned on LIBERO are trained and evaluated on the same ten instruction strings, and rewording the instruction changes base OpenVLA's success by -38.0 points. Test-time prompt ensembling, which improves language models, does not recover this loss in any setting we ran. Paraphrase consensus (the medoid action over K paraphrases) costs base OpenVLA 16.8 points when the training instruction is a member. Without it, the medoid of the paraphrases scores -32.4 points relative to the training instruction, and confidence-based selection scores -28.0. The same medoid over samples of one paraphrase improves on greedy decoding but stays -27.6 points below the training instruction, consistent with aggregation reducing variance without removing the bias the paraphrases share. A wrong-instruction probe measures how much of a policy's success depends on the instruction. Across three policies and four suites, paraphrases cost a policy only where this share is high, and the stronger policies lose a much smaller fraction of it than base OpenVLA. LoRA post-training on paraphrased instructions reduces the one-paraphrase effect to +2.0 points, against -32.0 for a matched control, reproduces across two seeds and on OpenVLA-OFT, transfers to withheld phrasings, and leaves the policy's reliance on the instruction unchanged.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在LIBERO上微调时，其训练和评估均基于相同的十条指令字符串，而改写指令会使基础OpenVLA的成功率下降38.0个百分点。测试时提示集成（一种可提升语言模型性能的方法）在我们运行的所有设置中均无法挽回这一损失。当训练指令作为候选之一时，释义共识（即K个释义动作的中位数）使基础OpenVLA损失16.8个百分点。若不包含训练指令，则释义中位数的得分相对于训练指令下降32.4个百分点，基于置信度的选择下降28.0个百分点。对单一释义的多个采样取中位数，其表现优于贪心解码，但仍比训练指令低27.6个百分点，这与聚合降低方差、但无法消除释义间共享偏差的结论一致。错误指令探针用于衡量策略成功在多大程度上依赖于指令本身。在三种策略和四组测试套件中，释义仅在依赖度较高时对策略造成损失，而更强的策略所损失的占比远低于基础OpenVLA。在释义指令上进行LoRA后训练可将单释义影响降至+2.0个百分点，而匹配对照组为-32.0个百分点；该结果在两个随机种子及OpenVLA-OFT上均能复现，并能迁移至未见的措辞，同时策略对指令的依赖度保持不变。

Authors: Hanlong Li, Sihan Tan, Takeshi Ashizawa, Benjamin Yen, Kazuhiro Nakadai

$S^3$-Nav: Structured Spatial-Semantic Decision Making for Language-Guided Robot Navigation VLN

language-guided navigation spatial-semantic state partial observability closed-loop navigation decision-making framework

简要说明：本文提出S^3-Nav，一种用于语言引导机器人导航的框架，通过分离持久空间语义状态与任务条件策略视图及独立执行验证，在部分可观测下提升了闭环导航可靠性。

TLDR: This paper introduces S^3-Nav, a framework for language-guided robot navigation that decouples persistent spatial-semantic memory from task-conditioned policy views and independent execution validation, improving closed-loop reliability under partial observability.

Abstract: This paper presents $S^3$-Nav, a structured spatial-semantic decision-making framework for language-guided robot navigation under partial observability. Rather than assuming a complete environment representation in advance, $S^3$-Nav incrementally constructs persistent spatial-semantic state while exposing only a capacity-controlled, task-conditioned view to the high-level policy. This separation decouples what the robot must retain from what the policy needs to inspect, allowing decision complexity to be controlled without discarding grounded evidence required for subsequent reasoning and validation. High-level navigation outputs remain provisional and are independently grounded and validated against persistent semantic evidence and current geometric observations before physical execution or task termination. Evaluations across multiple environments and object- and relation-goal tasks demonstrate that separating persistent state, decision-facing evidence, and execution authority improves closed-loop navigation reliability while reducing policy reasoning cost.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了S³-Nav，一种用于部分可观测条件下语言引导机器人导航的结构化空间语义决策框架。该框架并非预先假设完整的环境表示，而是增量式地构建持久化的空间语义状态，同时仅向高层策略暴露受容量控制、任务条件化的视图。这种分离将机器人必须保留的信息与策略需要检查的信息解耦，从而在不丢弃后续推理与验证所需的具象证据的前提下，控制决策复杂度。高层导航输出保持临时性，并在物理执行或任务终止之前，依据持久化语义证据和当前几何观测进行独立锚定与验证。在多种环境及物体目标和关系目标任务上的评估表明，将持久状态、决策面向证据与执行权限相分离，能够在降低策略推理成本的同时，提升闭环导航的可靠性。

Authors: Chaemin Lee, Hae Min Cho

Beyond Kinematic Tracking: Preserving Expressive Characteristics in Humanoid Whole-Body Control HumanoidEmbodied

residual learning whole-body control expressive motion motion-aware gating humanoid robot

简要说明：本文提出了一种带有补偿目标和运动感知门控的残差学习框架，以在仿人全身控制中保留富有表现力的运动特征，并在真实的 Unitree G1 机器人上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a residual learning framework with compensation objectives and motion-aware gating to preserve expressive motion characteristics in humanoid whole-body control, validated on a real Unitree G1 robot.

Abstract: Whole-body control plays a crucial role in enabling humanoid robots to execute expressive motions. Faithful execution requires preserving both the intended action and its expressive characteristics. Existing whole-body trackers typically balance joint and keypoint tracking with physical stability across diverse motions, but these objectives do not necessarily prioritize the expressive characteristics of each action. Our analysis shows that lower average positional tracking error does not guarantee better preservation of dynamic and postural motion characteristics. To address this gap, we propose a residual learning framework with compensation objectives targeting amplitude, energy, body expansion, body lean, and pelvis height. To concentrate compensation while limiting interference with the underlying tracking behavior, motion-aware gating allocates correction capacity according to body-part activity, preserving larger correction ranges in more active parts and restricting them elsewhere. For each frozen tracker, we train motion-specific residual policies and distill them into a unified policy shared across motion categories. Simulation and physical experiments on the Unitree G1 across eight motion categories demonstrate superior preservation of dynamic and postural motion characteristics compared with the corresponding baselines.

摘要（中文）：全身控制对于人形机器人执行富有表现力的动作至关重要。忠实的动作执行要求同时保留预期动作及其表现特征。现有的全身跟踪器通常在不同动作中平衡关节与关键点跟踪及物理稳定性，但这些目标并不一定优先考虑每个动作的表现特征。我们的分析表明，较低的平均位置跟踪误差并不能保证更好地保留动态和姿态动作特征。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种残差学习框架，其补偿目标针对振幅、能量、身体延展、身体倾斜和骨盆高度。为了在限制对底层跟踪行为干扰的同时集中补偿，运动感知门控根据身体部位的活动度分配校正能力，在更活跃的部位保留较大的校正范围，并在其他部位加以限制。对于每个冻结的跟踪器，我们训练动作特定的残差策略，并将其蒸馏为跨动作类别共享的统一策略。在Unitree G1上跨越八个动作类别的仿真和物理实验表明，与相应的基线相比，该方法在保留动态和姿态动作特征方面表现出更优异的性能。

Authors: Lingfan Bao, Hanshang Zhu, Yan Pan, Jincheng Wang, Jingyang Yu, Tianhu Peng, Yiyang Jia, Dimitrios Kanoulas, Chengxu Zhou

VLX-Go: Robust Embodied Tracking through Multi-Stage Learning and On-Policy Refinement VLA

vision-language waypoint policy embodied visual tracking on-policy refinement multi-stage learning distractor tracking

简要说明：VLX-Go提出了一种用于具身人物跟随的视觉-语言航点策略，通过多阶段学习（对齐、推理、跟踪专门化）和在线策略细化来提高干扰物跟踪成功率，达到58.22%并降低碰撞率。

TLDR: VLX-Go presents a vision-language waypoint policy for embodied person following, using multi-stage learning (alignment, reasoning, tracking specialization) and on-policy refinement to improve distractor-tracking success, achieving 58.22% success and reducing collisions.

Abstract: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment. Following an isolated person is a comparatively simple demonstration of embodied visual tracking, but following the intended person among distractors remains challenging. Existing methods exhibit a substantial drop in success from single-target to distractor tracking, motivating a focus on the shared spaces that person-following robots must navigate. We present \method{}, a vision--language waypoint policy built around the hypothesis that visual and language representations should be aligned before tracking-specific motion is learned. The policy combines complementary frozen visual encoders, multiscale temporal context, a transformer backbone, and a lightweight head for robot-centric waypoint prediction. Its training progresses through vision--language alignment, multimodal reasoning mid-training, and tracking specialization on 19,532 oracle episodes. Compared with 41.54\% distractor-tracking success for our earlier OmTrackVLA model, the complete multi-stage recipe achieves 55.80\%. We then explore on-policy refinement using filtered oracle labels for states visited by the policy. This preliminary study adds 2.42 percentage points of distractor-tracking success, reaching 58.22\%, while reducing collision rate by 1.99 pts. The final policy records the highest distractor- and ambiguous-tracking success rates among the compared methods. These results support staged multimodal learning as a promising direction for tracking among distractors and motivate further study of on-policy refinement for person following in shared spaces.

摘要（中文）：具身视觉追踪要求机器人从视觉观测中识别指定目标，并控制自身运动以在环境中跟随该目标。跟随一个孤立的人是具身视觉追踪中相对简单的示范，但在存在干扰者的情况下跟随目标人物仍具挑战性。现有方法在从单目标追踪到干扰者追踪的成功率上表现出显著下降，这促使我们关注跟随机器人必须导航的共享空间。我们提出\method{}，一种视觉-语言路径点策略，其核心假设是：在习得追踪专用运动之前，应先对齐视觉与语言表征。该策略结合了互补的冻结视觉编码器、多尺度时间上下文、Transformer骨干网络，以及用于机器人中心路径点预测的轻量级头。其训练过程依次经历视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理中间训练，以及在19，532条专家轨迹上的追踪特化。相比之下，我们早期的OmTrackVLA模型在干扰者追踪上的成功率为41.54%，而完整的多阶段方案达到了55.80%。随后，我们利用针对策略所访问状态的过滤专家标签，探索了策略内精调。这一初步研究使干扰者追踪成功率提升了2.42个百分点，达到58.22%，同时碰撞率降低了1.99个百分点。最终策略在对比方法中取得了最高的干扰者追踪和模糊目标追踪成功率。这些结果支持分阶段多模态学习作为在干扰者中追踪的一个有前景的方向，并激励在共享空间中进一步研究应用于人员跟随的策略内精调方法。

Authors: Kyusong Lee, Heting Ying, Tiancheng Zhao

PACER: Process-Aware VLA Policy Learning from Human Corrections for Robotic Disassembly VLA

VLA policy human corrections reweighting robotic disassembly supervised fine-tuning

简要说明：PACER提出了一种过程感知的修正与证据重加权框架，用于机器人拆解中VLA策略的监督微调，通过学习人类修正和策略回放来提高任务成功率。

TLDR: PACER introduces a process-aware correction and evidence reweighting framework for supervised fine-tuning of VLA policies in robotic disassembly, improving task success by learning from human corrections and policy rollouts.

Abstract: Robotic disassembly of end-of-life (EoL) products requires robots to accommodate product variation, follow prerequisite sequences, and approach components precisely for contact-rich manipulation. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provides a practical path for adaptation, but limited and costly disassembly data cannot capture the distribution shifts arising from changing environments and product uncertainties. The policy's own rollouts record its approach attempts, and human corrections demonstrate recovery from its errors, but turning these experiences into better policy performance remains challenging. We introduce PACER, a Process-Aware Correction and Evidence Reweighting framework that learns from these experiences through SFT, using progress toward the target and each trace's source and outcome to weight valid action chunks in the native supervised action loss. PACER trains one policy per weighting setting and selects one of the resulting policies through held-out validation. We evaluate PACER on UR5e motherboard disassembly across five component classes, where it achieves 87/100 successful approach-and-handoff trials on the held-out benchmark, compared with 54/100 for vanilla post-SFT.

摘要（中文）：机器人拆解报废产品需要机器人适应产品差异、遵循预设顺序并精确接近部件以进行高接触性操作。监督微调为适应提供了可行路径，但有限且昂贵的拆解数据无法捕捉由环境变化和产品不确定性引起的分布偏移。策略自身的轨迹记录了其接近尝试，人工修正则展示了从其错误中恢复的方法，但将这些经验转化为更好的策略性能仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了PACER，一个过程感知修正与证据重加权框架，通过监督微调从这些经验中学习，利用朝向目标的进展以及每条轨迹的来源和结果，对原生监督动作损失中的有效动作块进行加权。PACER为每种加权设置训练一个策略，并通过留出验证从中选择一个最终策略。我们在UR5e主板拆解任务上对PACER进行了评估，覆盖五类部件，在留出基准测试中，PACER实现了87/100次成功的接近与交接试验，而原始后监督微调仅为54/100。

Authors: Chang Liu, Sibo Tian, Litian Gong, Zhiwen Fan, Jiachen Li, Xiao Liang, Minghui Zheng

End-to-End Vision-Language-Action Policies for Autonomous Lunar Rover Docking VLA

vision-language-action policy lunar rover docking modular navigation pipeline closed-loop evaluation adaptive-horizon execution

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于月球车自主对接的视觉-语言-动作策略，在高保真仿真环境中通过安全感知专家示范进行训练，并在感知干扰下与模块化基线相比展现出具有竞争力的闭环性能，同时通过自适应执行视界来平衡计算与安全性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a vision-language-action policy for autonomous lunar rover docking, trained with safety-aware expert demonstrations in a high-fidelity simulation, and demonstrates competitive closed-loop performance against a modular baseline under perceptual disturbances while using adaptive-horizon execution to balance compute and safety.

Abstract: Surface navigation on the Moon is subject to extreme illumination contrast and deployment-time perceptual disturbances. While modular navigation pipelines have long supported planetary rover navigation, robustness is compromised by measurement errors that propagate through hand-engineered components. End-to-end learned policies are an alternative approach to navigation, which maps observations directly to control actions without intermediate components. Vision-language-action models, in particular, have driven significant breakthroughs in robotics and autonomous vehicle research. By leveraging internet-scale vision-language pretraining, these models can be exploited for their commonsense reasoning and visual understanding to provide robust generalization with limited task-specific data. However, their applicability and performance have yet to be characterized for lunar surface operations. In this study, we design a vision-language-action policy for autonomous lunar rover docking and characterize its performance relative to a modular navigation pipeline. We develop a scalable training framework that generates safety-aware expert demonstrations in a high-fidelity lunar simulation environment. In closed-loop evaluations, our policy performs competitively relative to the modular baseline under perceptual disturbances unseen during training. To address the tradeoff between compute consumption and closed-loop safety, the policy adapts its execution horizon by determining how far the rover may safely travel in open loop. Adaptive-horizon execution reduces inference frequency while limiting hazard-contact rates relative to fixed horizons in the evaluated scenarios.

摘要（中文）：月球表面的导航面临极端光照对比和部署期间感知干扰的挑战。尽管模块化导航流程长期以来一直支持行星探测车的导航任务，但其鲁棒性受到手工设计组件间测量误差传播的影响而有所削弱。端到端学习策略是导航的一种替代方法，它直接将观测映射到控制动作，无需中间组件。特别是视觉-语言-动作模型，已在机器人和自动驾驶车辆研究中取得了重大突破。通过利用互联网规模的视觉-语言预训练，这些模型可凭借其常识推理和视觉理解能力，在有限的任务特定数据下提供鲁棒的泛化性能。然而，其在月球表面作业中的适用性和性能尚未得到充分表征。在本研究中，我们设计了一种用于月球探测车自主对接的视觉-语言-动作策略，并将其性能与模块化导航流程进行了对比表征。我们开发了一个可扩展的训练框架，在高保真月球仿真环境中生成注重安全性的专家演示。在闭环评估中，我们的策略在训练中未见过的感知干扰下，其表现与模块化基线相当。为平衡计算消耗与闭环安全性之间的权衡，该策略通过确定探测车在开环条件下可安全行驶的距离来调整其执行周期。在所评估的场景中，与固定执行周期相比，自适应执行周期在降低推理频率的同时，控制了危险接触率。

Authors: Sitan Huang, Grace Gao

Into the LidarVerse: A Real-Time Unified LiDAR World Model Across Tasks and Sensors WorldModel

LiDAR world model unified generative framework real-time inference sensor simulation closed-loop

简要说明：LidarVerse 提出了一个统一的 LiDAR 世界模型框架，通过单一 tokenizer 架构结合重建与生成范式，支持跨传感器和任务的生成、预测及重模拟，并实现实时推理。

TLDR: LidarVerse introduces a unified conditional generative framework for LiDAR world modeling, combining reconstruction and generative paradigms into a single tokenizer-based architecture that supports generation, forecasting, and resimulation across sensors and tasks, with real-time inference.

Abstract: We present LidarVerse, a real-time unified LiDAR world model for sensor simulation across tasks and sensors. Existing LiDAR simulators largely follow one of two complementary paradigms: reconstruction-based methods preserve the geometry of a captured scene but require lengthy per-scene optimization, whereas generative methods amortize learning across data but lack the consistency needed for long-horizon rollouts. LidarVerse brings both paradigms into a single, unified conditional generative framework. A universal tokenizer maps LiDAR range sequences into a shared latent space, where a bidirectional teacher learns a common interface for conditioning on a LiDAR prefix, an HD-Map, a persistent spatial cache, and optionally, text. Varying the available scene evidence turns the same model into a generator of new worlds, a point-cloud forecaster, or a generalizable resimulator of observed scenes without per-scene optimization. We distill the teacher into a four-step autoregressive causal student and maintain both a rolling temporal K/V cache and a world-aligned spatial cache, enabling persistent long-horizon rollouts with real-time inference at 11 FPS on a single H100 GPU. LidarVerse achieves state-of-the-art performance on most reported metrics across all three evaluation protocols, while its tokenizer supports 32-, 64-, and 128-beam LiDAR and generalizes to an unseen scanning pattern. These results demonstrate that generative and reconstruction-grounded LiDAR simulation can be realized within one model, providing the core capabilities for future closed-loop sensor simulation.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了LidarVerse，一个用于跨任务和跨传感器仿真的实时统一激光雷达世界模型。现有的激光雷达仿真器主要遵循两种互补范式：基于重建的方法保留捕获场景的几何结构，但需要对每个场景进行耗时优化；而生成式方法则跨数据分摊学习成本，但缺乏长期推演所需的一致性。LidarVerse将这两种范式统一到一个条件生成框架中。一个通用分词器将激光雷达距离序列映射到共享潜空间，其中双向教师模型学习一个通用接口，用于对激光雷达前缀、高精地图、持久空间缓存以及可选的文本进行条件化。通过改变可用的场景证据，同一模型既可以生成新世界，也可以进行点云预测，或对观测场景进行可泛化的重仿真而无需逐场景优化。我们将教师模型蒸馏为四步自回归因果学生模型，并同时维护滚动时间键值缓存和世界对齐的空间缓存，从而在单个H100 GPU上以11 FPS的实时推理实现持久的长期推演。LidarVerse在三种评估协议的大多数报告指标上均达到最先进性能，同时其分词器支持32线、64线和128线激光雷达，并能泛化到未见过的扫描模式。这些结果表明，生成式和基于重建的激光雷达仿真可以在一个模型中实现，为未来的闭环传感器仿真提供了核心能力。

Authors: Henry Che, Xuanchi Ren, Sanja Fidler, Shenlong Wang, Laura Leal-Taixé, Shengyu Huang

A Mode-Unified, Continuous, and Biomimetic Control Strategy of a Robotic Lower Limb Prosthesis Locomotion

biomimetic control lower-limb prosthesis mode-unified impedance control terrain adaptation

简要说明：本文提出一种模式统一、连续的仿生控制策略用于机器人下肢假肢，通过径向基函数插值统一不同地形斜率下的阻抗参数，并在截肢者实验中验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a mode-unified, continuous biomimetic control strategy for robotic lower limb prostheses, using RBF interpolation to unify slope-dependent impedance parameters across walking, ramps, and stairs, and validating it with amputee experiments.

Abstract: Existing biomimetic lower-limb prosthesis controllers are commonly designed for discrete locomotion modes, requiring separate parameterizations for level walking, ramps, and stairs. We present a mode-unified prosthesis control framework that represents knee and ankle biomechanics continuously as functions of terrain slope and gait phase across those locomotion conditions. Locally optimized ascent and descent polynomial models were unified using radial basis function (RBF) interpolation, preserving the accuracy of the partitioned models while outperforming a global polynomial representation. The resulting biomechanics were transformed into continuous and slope-dependent impedance parameters and implemented within a single finite-state-machine (FSM) controller using bilateral sensing for gait-state estimation. Experiments with 10 individuals with transfemoral amputation demonstrated terrain-adaptive locomotion from level walking through ramps and stairs up to 35 degrees, including 13 degree ramp and 15 degree stair conditions absent from the underlying able-bodied (AB) dataset. Experimental results reproduced the principal slope-dependent biomechanical trends predicted by the unified model, with high agreement for knee-related measures (r-square = 0.82 - 0.99) and ankle kinematics (r-square= 0.78 - 0.96). These findings demonstrated that unified biomechanical parameterization enables a prosthesis control architecture across diverse terrain conditions while preserving key features of AB biomechanics without requiring independently tuned impedance parameter sets for each locomotion mode.

摘要（中文）：现有的仿生下肢假肢控制器通常针对离散的运动模式进行设计，需要分别为平地行走、坡道和楼梯设定独立的参数。我们提出了一种模式统一的假肢控制框架，将膝关节和踝关节的生物力学特性表示为这些运动条件下地形坡度和步态相位的连续函数。通过径向基函数插值对局部优化的上坡和下坡多项式模型进行了统一，既保持了分区模型的精度，又优于全局多项式表示。所得生物力学特性被转换为连续的、随坡度变化的阻抗参数，并在单一有限状态机控制器中实现，利用双侧传感进行步态状态估计。对10名大腿截肢者的实验表明，该系统能够在地形自适应条件下实现从平地行走到坡度达35度的坡道和楼梯的运动，其中包括底层健全人数据集未包含的13度坡道和15度楼梯条件。实验结果再现了统一模型预测的主要坡度相关生物力学趋势，膝关节相关测量指标（r²=0.82–0.99）和踝关节运动学指标（r²=0.78–0.96）的一致性较高。这些发现表明，统一的生物力学参数化方法能够在多种地形条件下实现假肢控制架构，同时保留健全人生物力学的主要特征，而无需为每种运动模式单独调整阻抗参数集。

Authors: Hanjun Kim, Sixu Zhou, John Shim, Xinyuan Guo, Kinsey R. Herrin, Aaron J. Young

FACT: A Multimodal Force-Action-Track Foundation Model for Human-to-Robot Dexterity Manipulation

Dexterous manipulation Force prediction Human-to-robot transfer Visual tracks Foundation model

简要说明：FACT 是一个用于灵巧操作的机器人基础模型，它在包含力测量的人体触觉数据集 EgoForce 和机器人示范上进行预训练，并通过视觉轨迹引导的粗规划与力-动作联合精修级联，提升下游机器人策略在少量示范下的学习效果。

TLDR: FACT is a robot foundation model for dexterous manipulation that pretrains on a new large-scale human tactile dataset (EgoForce) with force measurements and robot demonstrations, then cascades visual track-guided coarse planning with force-action joint refinement to improve downstream robot policy learning from few demonstrations.

Abstract: Human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative to costly robot data collection for dexterous manipulation, but most human datasets lack force measurements. Dexterous manipulation requires not only visual and proprioceptive understanding but also the ability to anticipate and regulate interaction forces. To scale force-aware human-robot co-training, we introduce EgoForce, a large-scale human tactile dataset capturing force-rich manipulation experience, and combine it with robot demonstrations for pretraining. We present FACT, a robot foundation model that cascades from prospective visual planning to force-aware refinement for dexterous manipulation. FACT comprises two jointly trained components. A Track-Guided Coarse Planner jointly predicts actions, future video, and visual tracks. Future video and visual tracks also provide a shared task representation that facilitates cross-embodiment knowledge transfer and coarse action generation. Building on this coarse plan, a Force-Action Joint Refiner jointly predicts future force and refines the coarse action, allowing anticipated force and action to shape each other during refinement. We evaluate the model on ten tasks requiring fine-grained coordination and force feedback, including tool use, musical instruments, and precision laboratory procedures. Using as few as 10 robot trajectories with 90 human trajectories for fine-tuning, FACT outperforms both baselines, with success-rate gains of up to 60 percentage points over T-Rex. Ablations show that force supervision in human pretraining data is crucial for downstream robot performance after fine-tuning, while visual track prediction and training with future-force prediction improve dexterous execution. Experiments varying the human-robot data ratio during fine-tuning further suggest that FACT learns from human demonstrations nearly as effectively as from robot demonstrations.

摘要（中文）：人类示范为灵巧操作提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，可替代成本高昂的机器人数据采集，但大多数人类数据集缺乏力测量信息。灵巧操作不仅需要视觉和本体感知能力，还需要预测和调节交互力的能力。为了扩展力感知的人机协同训练，我们引入了EgoForce——一个大规模的人类触觉数据集，捕捉富含力信息的操作经验，并将其与机器人示范结合用于预训练。我们提出了FACT，一个从前瞻性视觉规划级联到力感知细化的机器人基础模型，用于灵巧操作。FACT包含两个联合训练的组件。轨迹引导的粗规划器联合预测动作、未来视频和视觉轨迹。未来视频和视觉轨迹还提供了共享的任务表示，促进了跨实体知识迁移和粗动作生成。在此粗规划的基础上，力-动作联合细化器联合预测未来力并细化粗动作，使预测的力和动作在细化过程中相互塑造。我们在十个需要细粒度协调和力反馈的任务上评估了该模型，包括工具使用、乐器和精密实验室操作。仅使用10条机器人轨迹和90条人类轨迹进行微调，FACT即优于两种基线方法，相较于T-Rex成功率提升最高可达60个百分点。消融实验表明，人类预训练数据中的力监督对于微调后的下游机器人性能至关重要，而视觉轨迹预测和未来力预测训练则提升了灵巧执行能力。改变微调期间人机数据比例的实验进一步表明，FACT从人类示范中学习的效果几乎与从机器人示范中学习相当。

Authors: Zhi Cao, Yining Hong, Jiaolong Yang, Yejin Choi, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Huang Huang

Post-Training, Finetuning, and Steering:A Field Guide for Curating Training Data VLA

Vision-Language-Action models adaptation methods offline RL critic-based steering finetuning

简要说明：本文针对视觉-语言-动作模型在不同数据场景下的适应方法选择提供了实用指南，并在仿真和真实机器人任务上比较了微调、强化学习和基于评论家的引导方法。

TLDR: This paper provides a field guide for choosing adaptation methods for Vision-Language-Action models under different data scenarios, comparing finetuning, RL, and critic-based steering on simulated and real robot tasks.

Abstract: While Vision-Language-Action models have enabled impressive cross-task transfer in zero-shot settings, \emph{adaptation} methods are often necessary to achieve consistent performance on novel tasks. However, even though a wealth of methods for adaptation have been proposed, it is unclear how to choose the best method based on available trajectories. We close this gap by studying the impact of the adaptation method under a variety of common data scenarios: on- and off-policy data, offline vs online adaptation, and whether the data contains optimal or suboptimal trajectories. Our evaluation spans simulated tasks in the LIBERO suite and real tasks on a Franka platform. In the offline data regime, critic-based steering approaches outperform supervised finetuning when failure data is available. However, offline RL techniques for training critic functions fail to outperform simpler Monte-Carlo-based approaches. Finally, in the online setting, critic-based steering is significantly more sample efficient compared to policy-gradient-based finetuning methods, but has a lower performance ceiling than full finetuning.

摘要（中文）：虽然视觉-语言-动作模型在零样本场景下已展现出令人瞩目的跨任务迁移能力，但通常仍需采用\emph{适应}方法才能在全新任务上获得稳定性能。然而，尽管已有大量适应方法被提出，如何根据现有轨迹选择最优方法仍不明确。本研究通过考察多种常见数据场景下适应方法的影响来填补这一空白，这些场景包括：同策略与异策略数据、离线与在线适应，以及数据中包含最优或次优轨迹的情况。我们的评估覆盖LIBERO套件中的模拟任务以及Franka平台上的真实任务。在离线数据条件下，当存在失败数据时，基于评论员的引导方法优于监督式微调。然而，用于训练评论员函数的离线强化学习技术未能超越更简单的蒙特卡洛方法。最后，在在线场景中，基于评论员的引导相比基于策略梯度的微调方法具有显著更高的样本效率，但其性能上限低于完全微调。

Authors: Maria Attarian, Yifan Ruan, Claas Voelcker, Chenyang Cao, Amy Zhang, Peter Stone, Nicholas Rhinehart, Igor Gilitschenski

Collective Learning for Unified Robotic Manipulation via Predictive Dynamics Adaptation Manipulation

collective learning multi-embodiment manipulation predictive dynamics adapter zero-shot sim-to-real state-based policy

简要说明：PACE 提出了一种两阶段集体学习框架，通过预测动力学适配器将共享任务空间意图与具体体现的转移动力学分离，防止在多样化机器人上的性能崩溃，并实现零样本模拟到现实的迁移。

TLDR: PACE introduces a two-stage collective learning framework with a predictive dynamics adapter to separate shared task-space intent from embodiment-dependent transition dynamics, preventing performance collapse in unified robotic manipulation across diverse embodiments and achieving strong zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Learning a collective policy for state-based Cartesian manipulation across diverse robotic embodiments presents a fundamental challenge due to embodiment-dependent transition dynamics. Collective learning aggregates multi-robot experience to discover shared task structure, yet naive aggregation can average incompatible action modes when different embodiments realize the same Cartesian command through different transition behavior. This leads to strategy ambiguity and performance collapse on dynamically outlying embodiments. To address this, we propose PACE, a two-stage collective learning framework that separates shared task-space intent from embodiment-dependent transition dynamics. The first stage employs a representation layer pre-trained on offline trajectories to extract task-level context from collective data. The second stage introduces a decision layer equipped with a predictive dynamics adapter. By forcing the latent state to predict future transitions, this adapter acts as a latent regularizer that grounds the policy in the transition behavior of the executing robot while preserving real-time inference without online planning. Evaluations across simulated embodiments demonstrate that our method prevents performance collapse on distinct robots. It achieves over 93\% overall success and 89\% on dynamically out-of-distribution zero-shot simulated robots, outperforming the Transformer behavior cloning (82\%) and diffusion policy baselines (66\%). Physical KUKA deployment further validates the feasibility of the full state-based pipeline under zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

摘要（中文）：跨不同机器人本体实现基于状态的笛卡尔操作集体策略学习，因本体依赖的转移动态而构成根本性挑战。集体学习通过聚合多机器人经验来发现共享任务结构，然而，当不同本体通过不同转移行为实现相同笛卡尔命令时，朴素聚合可能平均化不兼容的动作模式，从而导致策略模糊，并在动态离群本体上引发性能崩溃。为解决这一问题，我们提出PACE，一种两阶段集体学习框架，将共享任务空间意图与本体依赖的转移动态分离。第一阶段采用在离线轨迹上预训练的表示层，从集体数据中提取任务级上下文。第二阶段引入配备预测动力学适配器的决策层。通过强制潜状态预测未来转移，该适配器充当潜在正则化器，将策略锚定在执行机器人的转移行为上，同时保持实时推理，无需在线规划。跨模拟本体的评估表明，我们的方法可防止不同机器人上的性能崩溃。其在整体任务上实现超过93%的成功率，在动态分布外零样本模拟机器人上实现89%的成功率，优于Transformer行为克隆（82%）和扩散策略基线（66%）。物理KUKA部署进一步验证了全状态管道在零样本仿真到现实迁移下的可行性。

Authors: Shaocheng Liu, Yuan Meng, Zhenshan Bing, Alois Knoll

DexMimic: A Generalist Dexterous Hand-Object Tracking Policy via Value-Guided Reset Allocation Manipulation

dexterous manipulation hand-object tracking generalist policy value-guided reset allocation learning from human interactions

简要说明：DexMimic提出了一种通用灵巧手-物体跟踪策略，通过价值引导的重置分配方法在不同HOI轨迹上联合训练，提升训练效率和零样本泛化能力，并在真实机器人上验证。

TLDR: DexMimic introduces a generalist dexterous hand-object tracking policy trained jointly across diverse HOI trajectories using a Value-Guided Reset Allocation method to improve training efficiency and enable zero-shot generalization, validated on a real robot.

Abstract: Achieving human-like dexterous manipulation remains a central challenge in robotics. Learning from human hand-object interaction (HOI) datasets offers a promising pathway to diverse dexterous skills, yet existing physics-based approaches train specialist policies for individual trajectories, thereby limiting skill reuse at scale. We introduce DexMimic, a generalist dexterous hand-object tracking policy jointly trained across diverse HOI trajectories. Efficient joint training requires allocating each rollout to both an undertrained phase and a starting state that supports continued tracking. DexMimic realizes this insight through Value-Guided Reset Allocation, which adapts the initialization distribution online to prioritize difficult phases and select reset states with higher expected tracking returns. We further introduce a benchmark spanning training, fine-tuning, and generalization. Experiments show improved tracking success and training efficiency, faster fine-tuning, and the potential for zero-shot generalization to unseen trajectories and objects; larger training sets further improve efficiency and generalization. Finally, we validate DexMimic on a real-world dexterous manipulation platform.

摘要（中文）：实现类人灵巧操作仍是机器人学的核心挑战之一。从人类手物交互数据集中学习，为获取多样化的灵巧技能提供了一条有前景的路径，然而现有基于物理的方法通常针对单条轨迹训练专用策略，限制了技能在大规模场景中的复用。我们提出DexMimic，一种跨多样手物交互轨迹联合训练的通用灵巧手物跟踪策略。高效的联合训练要求将每次轨迹展开同时分配给欠训练阶段以及能够支撑持续跟踪的起始状态。DexMimic通过价值引导的重置分配实现这一思想，该方法在线调整初始化分布，优先关注困难阶段，并选择具有更高期望跟踪回报的重置状态。我们进一步引入一个涵盖训练、微调和泛化的基准测试。实验表明，该方法在跟踪成功率、训练效率、微调速度方面均有提升，并且展现出对未见轨迹和物体进行零样本泛化的潜力；更大规模的训练集进一步提升了效率与泛化能力。最后，我们在真实灵巧操作平台上验证了DexMimic的有效性。

Authors: Zhexi Luo, Zhixuan Xu, Rui Yang, Zeyu Xiao, Yiwen Hou, Lin Shao

Tread: A Visuo-Inertial Framework for Terrain and Locomotion Context-Aware Gait-Phase and Speed Estimation in Wearable Robotics Locomotion

wearable robotics gait-phase estimation terrain perception locomotion mode identification inertial measurement units

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于可穿戴辅助机器人的视觉-惯性框架，通过胸挂相机和下肢IMU的因果流程，联合估计地形、运动模式、步态相位和步行速度，并在多种地形下取得高精度。

TLDR: This paper presents a visuo-inertial framework for wearable assistive robots that jointly estimates terrain, locomotion mode, gait phase, and walking speed using a chest-mounted camera and lower-limb IMUs, with a causal pipeline achieving high accuracy across terrain types.

Abstract: A wearable assistive robot must continuously estimate terrain, locomotion mode, gait phase, and walking speed. These quantities are commonly addressed by separate, terrain-specific models, with datasets rarely collected under a common protocol. This paper presents a visuo-inertial framework that connects these estimates through a causal pipeline using a chest-mounted camera and four lower-limb inertial measurement units (IMUs). Anticipatory Terrain Perception (ATP) classifies incoming terrain with 96.3% accuracy and anticipates terrain transitions by 1.46 s on average. Terrain-Aware Locomotion Mode Identification (TALMI) achieves 93.7% and 98.8% accuracy for its level-ground and stairs experts respectively, with mean transition latencies being below 200 ms. The relevant TALMI posterior is retained as a Probabilistic Locomotion Context (PLC) vector and provided to a shared Gait Kinematic Encoder (GKE), which supports 50-Hz bilateral gait-phase estimation and 2-Hz walking-speed estimation. Leave-one-subject-out evaluation yields gait-phase RMSEs of 1.75%, 2.97%, and 4.55% for level walking, stair ascent, and stair descent respectively while estimating speed over 3.5-5.5 km/h with a RMSE of 0.218 km/h. All inertial sensing based models use sensor-fused Euler angles as input rather than raw accelerometer and gyroscope signals, reducing dependence on sensor mounting variation.

摘要（中文）：可穿戴辅助机器人必须持续估计地形、运动模式、步态相位及步行速度。这些量通常由各自独立、针对特定地形的模型分别处理，且数据集很少在统一协议下采集。本文提出了一种视觉-惯性融合框架，通过因果处理管线，利用胸部安装的摄像头和四个下肢惯性测量单元（IMUs）将这些估计量联系起来。预判式地形感知（ATP）模块以96.3%的准确率对即将进入的地形进行分类，并平均提前1.46秒预判地形转换。地形感知运动模式识别（TALMI）模块在平地行走和楼梯行走两个专家模型中分别达到93.7%和98.8%的准确率，平均转换延迟低于200毫秒。相关的TALMI后验概率以概率运动上下文（PLC）向量的形式保留，并输入至共享的步态运动编码器（GKE），该编码器支持50 Hz的双侧步态相位估计和2 Hz的步行速度估计。留一受试者交叉验证结果显示，在平地行走、上楼梯和下楼梯三种工况下，步态相位估计的均方根误差（RMSE）分别为1.75%、2.97%和4.55%；在3.5–5.5 km/h速度范围内，速度估计的RMSE为0.218 km/h。所有基于惯性传感的模型均采用传感器融合后的欧拉角作为输入，而非原始加速度计和陀螺仪信号，从而降低了对传感器安装位置差异的依赖性。

Authors: Debadrata Sarkar, Akash Bachhar, Aman Arora

Contact-UAN: Unsupervised Actuator Networks as a Residual World Model for Humanoid Control HumanoidEmbodied

residual world model actor sim-to-real humanoid control contact-consistent replay force tracking

简要说明：Contact-UAN提出了一种无监督执行器网络作为残差世界模型，用于修正人形机器人的执行器仿真到现实差异，仅使用6.5分钟的真实行走数据训练，便能实现更低的扭矩、更好的力跟踪、柔顺性和鲁棒跳跃。

TLDR: Contact-UAN introduces an unsupervised actuator network as a residual world model to correct actuator sim-to-real gaps for humanoid control, enabling policies with lower torque, better force tracking, compliance, and robust jumps, trained on only 6.5 minutes of real-world walking data.

Abstract: Humanoid policies trained in simulation can transfer qualitatively to hardware while failing to transfer the force interactions learned during training, compromising torque efficiency, load regulation, and robustness to impacts. This failure can arise from actuator sim-to-real gaps because forces depend on actuator torques. We introduce Contact-UAN, a residual world model that preserves a simulator's physics priors while correcting actuator dynamics to align simulated rollouts with recorded hardware rollouts. For humanoid motion with contact, this requires contact-consistent replay: if hardware playback in simulation begins with misaligned contact wrenches, the residual model learns to correct reset artifacts rather than actuator discrepancies. Using only onboard proprioception, Contact-UAN infers the simulator-side stance-foot pose needed to initialize replay with consistent contact forces. We show that a UAN trained on 6.5 minutes of real-world walking data generalizes to tasks that benefit from accurate force and impulse regulation and produces policies that transfer seamlessly to the real world, yielding 20% lower running torque, 43% lower force-tracking error, extreme compliance, accurate impedance control, and dynamic, robust jumps.

摘要（中文）：仿真训练的人形机器人策略能够定性地迁移到硬件上，但训练过程中学习到的力交互却无法成功迁移，从而影响扭矩效率、负载调节能力和抗冲击鲁棒性。这种失败可能源于执行器的仿真到现实差距，因为力取决于执行器扭矩。我们提出了Contact-UAN，一种残差世界模型，它在保留仿真器物理先验的同时，修正执行器动力学，使仿真 rollout 与记录的硬件 rollout 对齐。对于涉及接触的人形运动，这需要接触一致的轨迹重放：如果仿真中的硬件回放从不对齐的接触力旋量开始，残差模型会学习修正重置伪影，而非执行器差异。仅利用机载本体感觉，Contact-UAN 推断仿真侧支撑脚位姿，以初始化具有一致接触力的轨迹重放。我们展示了在6.5分钟真实世界行走数据上训练的UAN能够泛化到受益于精确力和冲量调节的任务，并产生无缝迁移到真实世界的策略，实现了20%更低的运行扭矩、43%更低的力跟踪误差、极高的柔顺性、精确的阻抗控制以及动态、鲁棒的跳跃。

Authors: Nolan Fey, Khai Nguyen, Yash Prabhu, Gabriel B. Margolis, Pulkit Agrawal

Orbia: Do Generated Videos Form a Consistent 3D World? WorldModel

3D consistency benchmark interactive world models video generation exploration and revisit Gaussian rendering

简要说明：Orbia 是一个用于评估交互式视频世界模型三维一致性的基准，通过系统测试输入保持、生成内容持久性和三维自一致性，涵盖 720 个实例和 27 个模型。

TLDR: Orbia is a benchmark for evaluating the 3D consistency of interactive video world models by systematically testing input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency across 720 instances and 27 models.

Abstract: Video generators serve as interactive worlds for exploration and simulation, yet realistic and visually appealing frames do not necessarily depict a consistent 3D world. Existing benchmarks assess selected geometric properties or use vision-language models to judge memory and consistency, leaving systematic 3D evaluation underexplored. We introduce Orbia, the first benchmark dedicated to a systematic and comprehensive evaluation of 3D consistency in interactive world models. Through controlled exploration and revisit, we organize the evaluation into three dimensions: input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency. For input preservation, registered RGB-D references and annotated anchors support appearance, geometry, and spatial stability measurements. For generated-content persistence, we compare revisits to regions absent from the input image with their first generated observations to test whether models preserve what they create. For 3D self-consistency, cross-view depth and feature correspondence, regional scale agreement, and held-out Gaussian rendering test whether generated views describe the same 3D scene. Minute-long exploration and revisits further test long-term consistency. Our construction and annotation pipeline brings together public datasets, self-captured scenes, and simulation, yielding 720 instances across indoor and outdoor environments and six exploration-and-revisit protocols. Evaluation spans 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models through native-interface adapters. Our Orbia benchmark provides a systematic basis for diagnosing 3D inconsistency and developing more persistent video world models.

摘要（中文）：视频生成器作为交互式世界，用于探索和模拟，然而逼真且视觉上吸引人的帧并不必然描绘出一致的3D世界。现有基准要么评估特定的几何属性，要么利用视觉-语言模型来判断记忆与一致性，对系统的3D评估尚未充分探索。我们提出了Orbia，这是首个致力于系统全面评估交互式世界模型中3D一致性的基准。通过受控探索与重访，我们将评估组织为三个维度：输入保持、生成内容持久性以及3D自一致性。在输入保持方面，配准的RGB-D参考和标注锚点支持外观、几何和空间稳定性的测量。在生成内容持久性方面，我们将对输入图像中缺失区域的 revisit 与其首次生成观测进行比较，以测试模型是否保留其创造的内容。对于3D自一致性，跨视角深度与特征对应、区域尺度一致性以及留出高斯渲染测试生成的视角是否描述了相同的3D场景。分钟级探索与重访进一步测试长期一致性。我们的构建与标注流程整合了公开数据集、自采集场景和模拟，生成涵盖室内外环境及六种探索-重访协议的720个实例。评估涵盖27个基于文本、动作和相机条件的模型，通过原生接口适配器进行。我们的Orbia基准为诊断3D不一致性和开发更持久的视频世界模型提供了系统基础。

Authors: Dongyue Lu, Guian Fang, Hur Lim, Yonggang Wu, Yanrong Wang, Hongshan Chen, Shengju Qian, Yue Liao, Wei Chow, Lingdong Kong, Tianxin Huang, Yu Yang, Hongji Yang, Junchao Huang, Ao Liang, Yihao Wang, Zihan Wang, Rong Li, Hanlin Chen, Xin Wang, Wei Tsang Ooi, Mike Zheng Shou, Shuicheng Yan

VITAL: From Visual Motion to Precise Action AutonomousDriving

action tokenizer visual motion flow matching autonomous driving NAVSIM

简要说明：VITAL提出了一种基于视觉诱发的动作分词器，将视觉运动支架与紧凑残差编码相结合，用于自动驾驶，实现高效的流匹配动作预测和强化后训练，在NAVSIM基准上表现优异。

TLDR: VITAL introduces a vision-induced action tokenizer for autonomous driving that couples visual motion scaffolds with compact residual encoding, enabling efficient flow-matching-based action prediction and reinforcement post-training with strong NAVSIM benchmark performance.

Abstract: World-action models aim to turn visual anticipation into driving decisions, yet typically train action experts on trajectory representations defined independently of visual dynamics. This motivates deriving action targets directly from visual motion. We first examine a simpler setting in which trajectories are reconstructed from recorded future images. Even without the need for future prediction, reconstruction captures the dominant maneuver but leaves centimeter-scale errors. We therefore introduce VITAL (Vision-Induced Tokens for Action Learning), an action tokenizer that couples a visually derived motion scaffold with a compact residual encoding the trajectory error left by that scaffold. This representation makes visual motion the principal prediction target and gives small metric corrections a separate, normalized learning scale. Using flow matching, the action expert jointly predicts both components from the current image, ego state, and navigation command, without generating future images at inference. The same residual coordinates support bounded reinforcement post-training that refines execution while keeping the predicted visual scaffold fixed. With only one action denoising step, VITAL achieves 90.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, within 0.13 points of its ten-step score at 3.29x the end-to-end inference speed. Without retraining, it achieves 91.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest and 38.6 on navhard. Project page: https://worldbench.github.io/vital

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型旨在将视觉预期转化为驾驶决策，然而目前通常是在独立于视觉动态定义的轨迹表征上训练动作专家。这促使我们直接从视觉运动中推导动作目标。我们首先考察了一个更简单的设置，即从记录的未来图像中重建轨迹。即使无需未来预测，重建能够捕捉主导操作，但会留下厘米级误差。为此，我们提出了VITAL（用于动作学习的视觉诱导令牌），一种动作分词器，它将视觉导出的运动支架与紧凑残差相结合，后者编码了该支架留下的轨迹误差。这种表征使视觉运动成为主要预测目标，并为微小度量修正提供了独立的、归一化的学习尺度。利用流匹配，动作专家从当前图像、自身状态和导航指令中联合预测两个组件，在推理时无需生成未来图像。相同的残差坐标支持有界强化后训练，在保持预测的视觉支架不变的同时细化执行效果。仅需一步动作去噪，VITAL在NAVSIM v1 navtest上达到90.8 PDMS，与其十步分数相差0.13个点，端到端推理速度提升3.29倍。无需重新训练，它在NAVSIM v2 navtest上达到91.1 EPDMS，在navhard上达到38.6。项目页面：https://worldbench.github.io/vital

Authors: Ao Liang, Youquan Liu, Mingxiao Li, Wei Chow, Lingdong Kong, Yue Liao, Dongyue Lu, Yu Yang, Wei Yin, Runnan Chen

Enhancing Latent World Models with Associative Memory WorldModel

latent world model associative memory JEPA-style prediction representational collapse long-horizon planning

简要说明：本文提出一种记忆增强的潜在世界模型，通过内容寻址记忆库增强JEPA式预测，并利用自适应层归一化和互补损失防止表征崩溃，在长时程规划基准上取得最优性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank, using adaptive layer normalization and complementary losses to prevent collapse, achieving state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon planning benchmarks.

Abstract: World models trained via latent dynamics offer a scalable path for embodied planning, yet existing methods suffer from representational collapse, computational overhead, and limited long-horizon capability. We introduce a memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank. Our approach learns high-level representations directly from observations, operating at multiple temporal scales within a shared latent space, and conditions predictions via adaptive layer normalization. To prevent collapse and ensure effective memory usage, we design two complementary losses that encourage slot diversity and balanced temporal utilization. Experiments on PushT, Tworoom, Reacher, and OGBCube demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with a lightweight architecture, outperforming conventional latent world models on long-horizon planning tasks.

摘要（中文）：基于潜在动力学训练的世界模型为具身规划提供了一条可扩展的路径，然而现有方法仍面临表征坍缩、计算开销大以及长期任务能力受限等问题。我们提出了一种增强记忆的潜在世界模型，该模型在JEPA风格预测的基础上引入内容可寻址记忆库。我们的方法直接从观测中学习高层表征，在共享潜在空间内以多种时间尺度运行，并通过自适应层归一化对预测进行条件化处理。为防止表征坍缩并确保记忆的有效利用，我们设计了两项互补的损失函数，分别促进槽位多样性与时间利用均衡性。在PushT、Tworoom、Reacher和OGBCube上的实验表明，我们提出的方法以轻量级架构取得了最先进的性能，在长期规划任务上优于传统潜在世界模型。

world models action-conditioned prediction manifold learning Taylor polynomial fast planning

简要说明：本文提出了 Action Jets，一种估计动作条件数据流形局部泰勒多项式的方法，通过单次推理评估多个候选动作，实现快速规划，并在短时预测上超越了现有生成器。

TLDR: This paper introduces Action Jets, a method to estimate the local Taylor polynomial of the action-conditioned data manifold, enabling fast planning by evaluating many action candidates from a single inference and improving short-horizon prediction accuracy over state-of-the-art generators.

Abstract: World models are a powerful means of reasoning and planning, but many of these action-conditioned predictive models are high dimensional and computationally expensive. These challenges limit the number of action candidates that can be evaluated by a planner. We show that this cost is avoidable for planners over short horizons, which only require local information with respect to the current state. For a fixed state, the frames reachable by varying a low-dimensional action (a camera movement or an end-effector command) lie on a low-dimensional manifold. We estimate the local shape of that manifold directly via a network trained to estimate how each image region moves per unit of each action axis supervised by data collected from samples by the generator. A correction head fit to trajectory data estimates the shape of this manifold region up to a third-order Taylor polynomial. We call this network estimating the Taylor polynomial describing the manifold shape an Action Jet and compute its radius of validity in closed form. By traversing this approximation of the local manifold shape, we only have to perform inference once per state for any number of candidate actions. Scoring sixteen candidates from a single extraction is over 300x faster than with either source generator, and this gap widens with the number of candidates a planner evaluates. We measure against state-of-the-art action-conditioned generators, IRASim and WorldGym on BridgeData V2, a real 7-DoF manipulation benchmark, and FrameCrafter on DL3DV scenes, where we chart from the novel-view generators DepthSplat and LagerNVS. Because only the tangent comes from the generator and every other term from the data, the Action Jet also predicts held-out frames more accurately than IRASim, the generator that supplied its tangent, at short horizons and at over 100x less compute.

摘要（中文）：世界模型是推理和规划的有力工具，但许多动作条件下的预测模型维度高且计算开销大。这些挑战限制了规划器能够评估的候选动作数量。我们证明，对于短时域内的规划任务，这一成本是可以避免的，因为此类规划仅需当前状态附近的局部信息。对于固定状态，通过改变低维动作（如相机移动或末端执行器指令）所能到达的帧位于一个低维流形上。我们直接通过一个网络估计该流形的局部形状，该网络训练用于预测每个图像区域沿每个动作轴单位变化时的移动方式，其监督数据由生成器从样本中采集。一个拟合轨迹数据的校正头可将该流形区域的形状估计至三阶泰勒多项式。我们将这一估计流形形状的泰勒多项式的网络称为动作射流（Action Jet），并以闭式形式计算其有效半径。通过沿该局部流形形状近似进行遍历，对于任意数量的候选动作，每个状态只需执行一次推理。从单次提取中评估十六个候选动作的速度比任一源生成器快300倍以上，且随着规划器评估的候选数量增加，这一差距进一步扩大。我们在BridgeData V2（一个真实的7自由度操作基准）上与最先进的动作条件生成器IRASim和WorldGym进行对比，并在DL3DV场景上与FrameCrafter对比，同时从新型视角生成器DepthSplat和LagerNVS绘制结果。由于只有切向量来自生成器，其余各项均来自数据，Action Jet在短时域内对未观测帧的预测也优于提供其切向量的IRASim，且计算量降低超过100倍。

Authors: Anton Arapin, Chahyon Ku, Bernadette Bucher

EarlyCommit: Calibrated Word-by-Word Commitment for Robots Acting Before You Finish Speaking Manipulation

early commitment streaming speech calibrated probabilities text encoder human-robot interaction

简要说明：EarlyCommit 允许机器人在指令说完之前就根据微调文本编码器的校准概率做出目标物体选择，在未见过的词上比关键词匹配更早且更准确地做出承诺。

TLDR: EarlyCommit enables robots to commit to the intended object mid-speech by thresholding calibrated probabilities from a fine-tuned text encoder, improving early commitment accuracy on unseen words compared to keyword matching.

Abstract: Human listeners can often identify the intended object several words before an instruction ends. Robots, however, are typically designed to wait until the speaker has finished before deciding how to act. We present EarlyCommit, an open-source tool that lets a robot commit to the intended object while the instruction is being spoken. After every recognized word, a fine-tuned text encoder scores each object in the scene. The robot acts when the calibrated probability of the best object reaches a threshold tau set by the user, so 1 - tau is the accepted risk of choosing the wrong object. Otherwise, it waits or asks. The tool includes a streaming speech front end, a scene and instruction generator with exact word-by-word ground truth, and scripts to train, calibrate, and evaluate. On instructions containing words never seen in training, EarlyCommit commits correctly 1.6 to 2 times as often as keyword matching, is right at least 92 percent of the time when it commits at tau = 0.9, and needs 31 to 35 ms per word on consumer GPUs.

摘要（中文）：人类听众通常能在指令结束前几个词就识别出目标物体。然而，机器人通常被设计为在说话者说完之后才决定如何行动。我们提出了EarlyCommit，一个开源工具，让机器人能在指令被说出的过程中就对目标物体做出承诺。每识别出一个词，一个微调后的文本编码器就会对场景中的每个物体进行评分。当最佳物体的校准概率达到用户设定的阈值τ时，机器人便采取行动，因此1-τ即为接受选错物体的风险。否则，它会等待或询问。该工具包含一个流式语音前端、一个带有逐词精确真值的场景和指令生成器，以及用于训练、校准和评估的脚本。在包含训练中从未出现过的词汇的指令上，EarlyCommit正确提交的频率是关键词匹配的1.6至2倍，在τ=0.9时提交的情况下，其正确率至少为92%，并且在消费级GPU上每个词的处理时间仅为31至35毫秒。

Authors: Muhammad Haris Khan

Tiered-Resolution Volumetric Mapping for Real-Time Simultaneous Planning and Mapping on Natural Outdoor Environments Other

tiered-resolution mapping volumetric mapping real-time planning LiDAR integration outdoor navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于户外机器人实时规划的分层分辨率体素映射系统，在规划路径附近以精细分辨率集成 LiDAR，其余区域使用粗略分辨率，从而减少地图大小和 CPU 时间，同时保持路径质量。

TLDR: This paper introduces a tiered-resolution volumetric mapping system for real-time planning on outdoor robots, integrating LiDAR at fine resolution around the planned path and coarse elsewhere, reducing map size and CPU time while maintaining path quality compared to uniform fine maps.

Abstract: Real-time volumetric mapping for a planning robot is dominated by the cost of integrating and storing information at the finest resolution, yet only a small fraction of any map ever lies on or near a path the planner actually considers. We exploit this with a tiered-resolution mapping mechanism that integrates LiDAR into a single map structure at two resolutions simultaneously: fine inside a corridor around the robot's current plan, and coarse everywhere else. As opposed to traditional navigation pipelines where path planning uses the mapping result and provides no feedback, we propose a feedback loop where planning also informs mapping to dynamically integrate information at different leaf resolutions. Across two real-world teleoperated datasets, replayed and scored offline against an independent full-resolution map, the tiered maps are 13-15x smaller and require 6-8x less integration CPU time than a uniform fine map, while producing paths at a similar cost per meter as the ones generated from fine resolution maps on both scenarios. A uniform coarse map reaches the same size savings but its path quality collapses (+210% cost per meter) on the harder scenario, because it over-discretizes terrain the robot must traverse. Tiering approximates the coarse map's cheapness without its failure mode.

摘要（中文）：实时体积映射在规划机器人中的应用主要受限于在最高分辨率下整合和存储信息的成本，然而在任何地图中，仅有一小部分区域真正位于规划器所考虑的路径之上或其附近。我们利用这一特性，提出了一种分层分辨率映射机制，该机制将激光雷达数据同时以两种分辨率整合到单一地图结构中：在机器人当前计划周围的走廊内采用精细分辨率，而在其余区域则采用粗略分辨率。与传统导航流程中路径规划仅使用映射结果而不提供反馈不同，我们提出了一种反馈循环，使规划也能指导映射过程，从而以不同的叶子分辨率动态整合信息。在两个真实遥操作数据集上，通过离线回放并对照独立的完整分辨率地图进行评估，分层地图的尺寸比均匀精细地图小13至15倍，且整合所需的CPU时间减少6至8倍，同时生成的路径在每米成本上与两种场景下由精细分辨率地图生成的路径相当。均匀粗略地图虽能达到相同的尺寸节省，但在较复杂场景中其路径质量显著下降（每米成本增加210%），原因在于其对机器人必须穿越的地形进行了过度离散化。分层策略在保持粗略地图成本优势的同时，避免了其失效模式。

Authors: Afonso E. Carvalho, David Portugal, Paulo Peixoto, George Kantor

Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness RLRobot

agentic robots vision-language-action models world models world-action models robotic foundation models

简要说明：本文对智能体机器人进行了统一综述，将现有研究按模型、数据、环境和工具四个功能领域进行组织，并追溯了从机器人策略到智能体系统的演变，涵盖VLA模型、世界模型和世界动作模型。

TLDR: This paper provides a unified survey of agentic robots, organizing existing research across four functional domains (Model, Data, Environment, and Harness) and tracing the evolution from robot policies to agentic systems, covering VLA models, world models, and world-action models.

Abstract: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.

摘要（中文）：基础模型正推动机器人智能领域的一场范式转变，从低层次的动作预测迈向对数据收集、模型训练、任务规划及现实世界执行的目标导向性统筹协调。我们将这一新兴范式定义为智能体机器人，其中智能体能够理解人类指令、与机器人环境交互、自主纠正执行错误，并动态调整操作策略。尽管该领域发展迅速，但现有研究之间尚未形成良好的衔接。研究人员对于如何将不同的智能体功能整合为完整的机器人系统缺乏一致的视角。本文对智能体机器人现有研究进行了统一概述。我们首先梳理了从机器人策略到智能体系统的发展脉络，涵盖视觉-语言-动作模型、世界模型以及世界-动作模型。随后，我们阐明了智能体机器人的定义与范畴，并将现有研究归纳为四大功能领域的十七个类别：模型、数据、环境与驾驭框架。在这些领域中，我们考察了智能体如何塑造模型学习与机器人决策、如何收集与整理机器人数据、如何构建用于学习与评估的世界、任务及测试环境，以及如何组织机器人使用所需的能力体系。最后，我们探讨了当前面临的开放性挑战，并指出了未来研究的方向。展望未来，我们希望本工作能够促进对智能体机器人的更清晰理解，并为其在能力、可靠性和适应性方面的提升提供新的研究思路支持。

Authors: Chonghan Qin, Dongming Wu, Kaituo Feng, Jiaxu Wang, Xinlei Yu, Peiwen Sun, Yijia Fan, Xilin He, Bingao Chen, Weitong Lian, Ryan Ji, Wenqi Ren, Xiaobin Hu, Dahua Lin, Yu-Gang Jiang, Xiangyu Yue

Human Demonstrations as Post-Training Data for Any Robot Body: Retargeting the Object, Not the Hand Manipulation

object-centric retargeting human demonstrations post-training data simulation-based feasibility check URDF

简要说明：本文提出将来自手机等简单设备的人类演示转换为与机器人本体无关的物体中心记录，并通过仿真中的运动学可行性检查将任务重定向到任何机器人，从而为不同机器人提供后训练数据。

TLDR: This paper proposes converting human demonstrations from simple devices like mobile phones into body-free object-centric records, which are then used to retarget tasks to any robot via kinematic feasibility checks in simulation, enabling post-training data for diverse embodiments.

Abstract: Human demonstrations are today used largely for pretraining vision-language-action models, with little ability to use the same data for target-embodiment or task-oriented training, which scalable deployment of robots in industrial and general environments depends on. A human demonstration recorded on a simple and scalable device such as a mobile phone can serve as post-training data for a robot whose body differs in structure and capability from the human who recorded it. This is made possible not by retargeting the hand's motion but the object's. A capture yields a body-free record: the object's pose over time, its contact intervals, and a reconstructed 3D object with provenance. Any robot, given as a URDF and a short descriptor, is solved against that record and scored in simulation against the demonstrated object motion as ground truth: the human-to-simulation leg of human-to-simulation-to-robot transfer, measured per robot. Each (robot, episode) pair gets one outcome: pass, failure with a named mode, or refusal, with its reason, before any motion. The method runs as a working system over a growing collection; the set analysed here is a sample of it: 42 captures solved on 8 robots, 157 pairs, of which 31.2% pass, 52.2% fail, 14.0% are refused and 2.5% are unauditable (kinematic feasibility, +/-50 mm / +/-15 deg, in simulation). Refusals held up: every pair the checks refuse on stored evidence yet ran anyway failed (13 of 13; 5 on a body whose public model welds its hand). A description file could not be shown to screen a robot: its outcomes were barely more predictable than guessing. No policy has yet been trained on the record. The record decides what a robot may post-train on; whether the policy then works on the real robot is the simulation-to-robot question, answered downstream.

摘要（中文）：人类演示目前主要用于预训练视觉-语言-动作模型，而很少能够利用同样的数据针对目标本体或任务导向进行训练，而机器人在工业及通用环境中的规模化部署恰恰依赖于后者。一部由手机等简单可扩展设备录制的人类演示，可以作为训练后数据，供机器人体态与录制演示的人类在结构和能力上均不相同的情况下使用。实现这一点并非通过重新定位手的运动，而是通过重新定位物体的运动来实现。一次采集生成一份无本体的记录：物体随时间变化的位姿、接触时间间隔，以及重建出的带来源信息的3D物体。任何机器人，只要提供URDF文件和简短描述，即可针对该记录进行求解，并在仿真中以演示的物体运动作为基准进行评分：这就是“人-仿真-机器人”迁移中的人到仿真环节，按每个机器人分别度量。每个（机器人，演示片段）组合会得到一个结果：通过、失败（附失败模式名称），或拒绝（附拒绝原因），全部在动作执行之前判定。该方法作为一个工作系统，在持续扩大的数据集上运行；本文分析的数据集是该系统的一个样本：42次采集在8个机器人上求解，共157个组合，其中31.2%通过，52.2%失败，14.0%被拒绝，2.5%无法审计（在仿真中按运动学可行性、±50毫米/±15度标准判定）。拒绝判定的可靠性得到了验证：所有被检查拒绝却仍执行存储证据的组合均失败（13个中13个失败；其中5个发生在公开模型将手部焊接固定的本体上）。描述文件无法用于筛选机器人：其筛选结果的预测价值几乎与随机猜测无异。目前尚未基于这些记录训练任何策略。记录决定了机器人可以进行何种训练后学习；而策略在真实机器人上是否有效，则属于“仿真到机器人”问题，由下游环节回答。

Authors: Nagasrikanth Kallakuri

Efficient Test-Time Adaptation For Robot Policies RLRobot

test-time adaptation locomotion self-supervised entropy regularization memory-guided

简要说明：本文提出TEMPO，一种测试时熵正则化、记忆引导的策略优化方法，用于在领域偏移情况下在设备上自适应预训练的机器人运动策略，利用冻结的评论家进行自监督适应。在仿真和真实四足机器人上，该方法在不同偏移（包括负载变化）下均表现出一致的性能提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces TEMPO, a test-time entropy-regularized, memory-guided policy optimization method that adapts pretrained robot locomotion policies on-device under domain shift, using a frozen critic for self-supervised adaptation. It demonstrates consistent performance improvements across simulated and real quadruped robots under various shifts, including payload changes.

Abstract: Reinforcement-learning policies for robot locomotion can fail at deployment when operating conditions shift (e.g., rough or slippery terrain, payload changes, sensing degradation), and retraining or manual recalibration is often infeasible under on-device latency and memory constraints. We study test-time adaptation (TTA) for robotic control: adapting a pretrained policy online and in a self-supervised manner during execution, without access to rewards. Our starting point is a lightweight baseline that updates only the actor using a frozen pretrained critic as a deployment-time performance surrogate. Building on this, we introduce TEMPO, a test-time entropy-regularized, memory-guided policy optimization method that stabilizes critic-driven updates under severe shift. TEMPO combines (i) an entropy-promoting regularizer on the critic's predictive distribution to mitigate overconfident extrapolation, and (ii) a score-based memory, inspired by prioritized replay, that prioritizes low-value ("hard") observations and applies importance sampling to focus limited computation on the most informative deployment conditions. Across Go1, Go2, and G1 in MuJoCo Playground under four representative shifts and multiple architectures, TEMPO yields consistent gains, reaching up to 80% improvement in a single-device setting. We further validate on a physical Unitree Go2 with an added calf payload, where fully on-device adaptation improves performance over the non-adapted baseline across real-world episodes.

摘要（中文）：强化学习策略在机器人 locomotion（运动控制）中的应用，在运行条件发生变化时（例如崎岖或湿滑地形、负载变化、传感性能退化）可能于部署阶段失效，而在设备端延迟和内存约束下，重新训练或手动重新校准往往不可行。我们研究机器人控制的测试时自适应（TTA）方法：在部署期间以在线自适应、自监督的方式调整预训练策略，而无需访问奖励信号。我们的出发点是一个轻量级基线方法，该方法仅利用冻结的预训练评论家（critic）作为部署时的性能代理，仅更新策略网络（actor）。在此基础上，我们提出TEMPO——一种测试时熵正则化、记忆引导的策略优化方法，在严重分布偏移下稳定评论家驱动的更新。TEMPO结合了：（i）在评论家预测分布上引入熵促进正则化，以缓解过度自信的外推问题；以及（ii）一种基于评分的记忆机制，受优先经验回放启发，优先考虑低价值（“困难”）观测，并应用重要性采样将有限计算集中于最具信息量的部署条件。在MuJoCo Playground中的Go1、Go2和G1平台上，面对四种代表性偏移场景和多种架构，TEMPO均取得一致性能提升，在单设备设置下最高可提升80%。我们还在带有附加小腿负载的物理Unitree Go2上进行了进一步验证，在该场景中，全设备端自适应相对于未自适应基线，在真实世界多次试验中持续提高了性能。
