Authors: Ana-Ştefania Kogălniceanu, Klára Orbán, Ashwin Nedungadi, Stefan Lüdtke, Kuderna-Iulian Benţa

Mixed-Reality Feedback Control: Towards Blending of Control and Digital Twinning Other

mixed-reality feedback control digital twin co-simulation multi-reality plants

简要说明：本文提出了一个框架，用于在多个现实（如仿真和物理装置）之间混合控制输入和反馈信号，以支持机器人和自主系统的数字孪生及混合现实反馈控制。

TLDR: The paper proposes a framework for mixing control inputs and feedback signals across multiple realities (e.g., simulations and physical setups) to support digital twinning and mixed-reality feedback control for robots and autonomous systems.

Abstract: Technologies, such as co-simulation, in particular, digital twins (DTs) are used for comprehensive and reliable prototyping, verification and validation (V&V) of control systems. There, the combination of feedback loops across multiple realities (e.g., simulations, physical setups) enables various forms of experimentation with robots and autonomous systems. However, the handling of multiple realities requires a more specific support by the modelling techniques used in control engineering. To streamline the latter in the system life cycle, we propose a framework for mixing (i.e., fusing, defusing) control input and feedback signals (i.e., stimuli, responses) in simultaneously operated plants for multiple realities.

摘要（中文）：诸如联合仿真等技术，特别是数字孪生（DTs），被用于控制系统全面且可靠的样机开发、验证与确认（V&V）。在此过程中，跨多重现实（例如，仿真、物理装置）的反馈回路组合，使得对机器人和自主系统的多种形式实验成为可能。然而，处理多重现实要求控制工程中所使用的建模技术提供更具体的支持。为了在系统生命周期中简化这一过程，我们提出了一种框架，用于在同时运行的多重现实设备中混合（即，融合、解除融合）控制输入和反馈信号（即，激励、响应）。

Authors: Melisa Soydan, Mario Gleirscher

What Happens to the Goal? Distinct Failures of Policy Alignment in Goal Misgeneralization RLRobot

goal misgeneralization policy alignment reinforcement learning Procgen environments robot tasks

简要说明：本文分析了强化学习智能体在Procgen环境和机器人任务中的目标误泛化现象，识别出三种不同的策略-目标错位失败模式及其对恢复策略的影响。

TLDR: This paper analyzes goal misgeneralization in reinforcement learning agents across Procgen environments and robot tasks, identifying three distinct policy-goal misalignment failure modes and their implications for recovery strategies.

Abstract: Goal misgeneralization is a common failure mode in which an agent behaves competently out of distribution but does not pursue the intended goal. However, we still have a weak understanding of what happens to the intended goal in misgeneralizing agents. Across three Procgen environments and five robot tasks, we find three distinct forms of policy-goal misalignment: (1) functional target substitution, where behavior follows an alternative goal, (2) a policy shortcut, where behavior follows a learned action strategy, and (3) cue competition between intended and proxy goal cues. We distinguish these regimes by tracing where goal information remains available internally, how strongly it influences the policy, and what role it plays in action selection, and find that the goal is lost at different depths. Where the goal reaches the decision, as in cue competition, steering redirects the policy to the goal's location, raising intended-goal reach from 16.0% to 95.3%. Where it reaches the policy but not the decision, only new downstream wiring recovers goal reach, from 31.6% to 84.3% in the environment with the action shortcut. Where it is inert, neither works. Our results show that goal misgeneralization is not a single failure of goal representation, but distinct failures of policy alignment at different depths, tightly connected to which recovery works.

摘要（中文）：目标误泛化是一种常见的失效模式，即智能体在分布外场景中表现出能干的行为，却并未追求预期目标。然而，对于误泛化智能体中预期目标究竟发生了什么，我们目前的理解仍较为有限。在三个Procgen环境与五个机器人任务中，我们发现了三种不同形式的策略-目标错位：（1）功能性目标替代，即行为遵循替代目标；（2）策略捷径，即行为遵循习得的动作策略；（3）预期目标线索与代理目标线索之间的线索竞争。我们通过追踪目标信息在内部何处仍然可用、其对策略的影响强度以及其在动作选择中所扮演的角色来区分这三种模式，并发现目标在不同深度上发生丢失。当目标能够到达决策层时（如线索竞争情形），转向干预能够将策略重新引导至目标位置，使预期目标达成率从16.0%提升至95.3%。当目标到达策略层但未到达决策层时，只有新增下游连接才能恢复目标达成率，在存在动作捷径的环境中，该比率从31.6%提升至84.3%。当目标处于惰性状态时，两种方法均无效。我们的结果表明，目标误泛化并非目标表征的单一失效，而是不同深度上策略对齐的多种不同失效，且与哪种恢复方法有效密切相关。

Authors: Julia Barth, Armin Sommer, Kunvar Thaman, Jannik Schilling

Dungeon and Visibility World Generator Other

environment generator visibility robotic exploration reproducible line-of-sight

简要说明：本文介绍了Dungeon and Visibility World Generator，这是一个开源框架，用于创建具有可控几何形状和基于Rust的可见性引擎的可复现2D和3D环境，旨在评估机器人探索、覆盖和多智能体部署算法。

TLDR: This paper introduces the Dungeon and Visibility World Generator, an open-source framework for creating reproducible 2D and 3D environments with controllable geometry and a Rust-based visibility engine, aimed at evaluating robotic exploration, coverage, and multi-agent deployment algorithms.

Abstract: Robotic exploration, coverage, and multi-agent deployment algorithms require reproducible environments with controllable geometry and visibility. This paper presents the Dungeon and Visibility World Generator, an open-source framework for constructing two- and three-dimensional environments and evaluating geometric line-of-sight. The framework supports orthogonal, polygonal or polyhedral, and curvilinear geometries, with six construction families covering scattered rooms, clusters, winding passages, caverns, branches, and loops. Room dimensions, passage structures, obstacles, and spatial placement can be controlled through configurable parameters and probability distributions. Each generated environment provides continuous free-space geometry and a corresponding discrete occupancy representation. A Rust-based visibility engine supports line-of-sight queries in both representations, enabling the evaluation of observable regions from arbitrary agent positions. The framework records configurations, generated geometries, occupancy grids, and visibility results to support reproducible experiments. We demonstrate the generator across all six geometry classes, examine how geometry and spatial resolution affect visibility, and evaluate generation time and reproducibility. The resulting framework provides a configurable foundation for evaluating robotic exploration, coverage, and multi-agent deployment algorithms in diverse environments.

摘要（中文）：机器人探索、覆盖以及多智能体部署算法需要具备可控几何形状与可视性的可复现环境。本文介绍了地牢与可视性世界生成器，这是一个开源框架，用于构建二维和三维环境并评估几何视线。该框架支持正交、多边形或多面体以及曲线几何，并提供了六种构建族系，涵盖散落房间、簇群、蜿蜒通道、洞穴、分支和环路。房间尺寸、通道结构、障碍物及空间布局可通过可配置参数和概率分布进行控制。每个生成环境都提供连续自由空间几何及对应的离散占据表示。基于Rust的可视性引擎支持在两种表示中进行视线查询，从而能够评估任意智能体位置的可观测区域。该框架记录配置、生成几何、占据栅格及可视性结果，以支持可复现实验。我们展示了生成器在全部六类几何中的表现，考察了几何与空间分辨率对可视性的影响，并评估了生成时间与可复现性。该框架为在多样化环境中评估机器人探索、覆盖及多智能体部署算法提供了可配置的基础。

Authors: Edwin Mériaux, Antonio Loría, Gregory Dudek

A Master-to-Simulation Interface with Demonstration-Trajectory Guidance for Vascular Intervention Manipulation

vascular intervention master-to-simulation SOFA demonstration trajectory guidance physical phantom experiment

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人血管介入的主端到仿真（SOFA）接口，并通过物理模型实验证明，与无引导或中心线引导相比，重用成功演示轨迹作为视觉引导可显著提高任务性能。

TLDR: This paper presents a master-to-simulation (SOFA) interface for robotic vascular intervention, and demonstrates that reusing successful demonstration trajectories as visual guidance significantly improves task performance in physical phantom experiments compared to no guidance or centerline guidance.

Abstract: Robotic vascular intervention can reduce radiation exposure to physicians and improve manipulation stability, but effective guidance remains challenging because conventional fluoroscopic images provide limited spatial information. This paper developed a vascular intervention interactive system that connects a real robotic master controller with the SOFA(Simulation Open Framework Architecture) physical simulation platform and reused successful operation trajectories as visual guidance in physical phantom experiments. Experiments were conducted to validate the master-to-SOFA control loop and to compare three guidance conditions: no guidance, centerline guidance, and successful-trajectory guidance. The control validation results showed reliable command delivery under velocity-mode operation. In the physical phantom experiment, centerline guidance showed no obvious improvement over no guidance. In contrast, successful trajectory guidance provided a clear performance benefit. Compared with the no-guidance condition, it reduced task completion time, collision number, rollback number, and rotation number by approximately 66.8%, 34.3%, 55.6%, and 66.7%, respectively. These results indicate that successful trajectories obtained under instrument-vessel interaction can provide practical guidance cues, offering a simple and effective visual assistance strategy for robotic vascular intervention experiments.

摘要（中文）：机器人血管介入可减少医生受辐射剂量并提升操作稳定性，但由于传统透视图像提供的空间信息有限，有效引导仍具挑战。本文构建了一个将真实机器人主控端与SOFA（模拟开放框架架构）物理仿真平台相连接的血管介入交互系统，并在实体体模实验中复用成功操作轨迹作为视觉引导。实验验证了主控端至SOFA的控制回路，并比较了三种引导条件：无引导、中心线引导和成功轨迹引导。控制验证结果表明，在速度模式下指令传递可靠。在实体体模实验中，中心线引导相较于无引导无明显改善；而成功轨迹引导则展现出显著性能优势。与无引导条件相比，任务完成时间、碰撞次数、回退次数和旋转次数分别减少了约66.8%、34.3%、55.6%和66.7%。上述结果表明，在器械-血管相互作用下获取的成功轨迹能够提供实用的引导线索，为机器人血管介入实验提供了一种简单有效的视觉辅助策略。

Authors: Mingyu Zou, Shuxiang Guo, Sheng Cao, Pengcheng Li, Jian Guo, Bin Wang, Mingchao Din

Probabilistic Physics Digital Twin for Human-Robot Interaction Other

probabilistic digital twin human-robot interaction uncertainty robot planning simulation

简要说明：本文提出概率数字孪生方法，将不确定的物理属性表示为概率分布，以支持人机交互中的鲁棒模拟和规划。

TLDR: This paper proposes probabilistic digital twins that represent uncertain physical properties as probability distributions, enabling robust simulation and planning for human-robot interaction.

Abstract: Digital twins are increasingly used in robotics to simulate interactions, predict action outcomes, and support planning. However, constructing accurate digital twins requires precise estimates of physical properties such as mass, friction, and center of mass, which are often difficult to obtain in real-world environments. We propose probabilistic digital twins, which represent uncertain physical properties as probability distributions rather than fixed values. By simulating actions across these distributions, the twin predicts a range of possible outcomes and their likelihoods. These probabilistic simulations can guide both human and robot actions by identifying actions that are effective despite physical uncertainty. We demonstrate this framework through human-robot interaction scenarios, including interfaces that communicate simulated outcomes to users and robot planning strategies that explicitly account for uncertainty.

摘要（中文）：数字孪生在机器人技术中的应用日益广泛，用于模拟交互、预测行动结果以及辅助规划。然而，构建精确的数字孪生需要对质量、摩擦力和质心等物理属性进行精确估算，而这些属性在现实环境中往往难以获取。为此，我们提出概率数字孪生的概念，将不确定的物理属性表示为概率分布，而非固定值。通过对这些分布上的动作进行模拟，该孪生模型能够预测一系列可能的结果及其发生的可能性。这些概率性模拟通过识别在物理不确定性下依然有效的动作，能够同时指导人类和机器人的行动。我们通过人机交互场景展示了这一框架，包括向用户传达模拟结果的交互界面，以及明确考虑不确定性的机器人规划策略。

Authors: Yushen Hu, Harshvardhan Chandirasekar, Apurv Kushwaha, Jonathan King, Zhu-Tian Chen

MIND: Instruction-Conditioned Incremental Grounding for Robots Other

incremental grounding instruction-conditioned language model robots target selection

简要说明：MIND 是一个框架，通过使用语言模型编译依赖关系和事件足迹，增量维护具身代理在持续语言指令下的目标房间决策，在保持决策准确性的同时减少语义评估次数。

TLDR: MIND is a framework that incrementally maintains target-room decisions for persistent language instructions in embodied agents by using a language model to compile dependencies and event footprints, reducing semantic evaluations while preserving decision accuracy.

Abstract: Robots following persistent language instructions must decide which cached room judgments remain valid as their environment changes. We present MIND (Maintenance via INstruction-conditioned Dependencies), a framework for maintaining target-room decisions without re-evaluating every room after each event. A language model compiles each instruction into dependencies for semantic qualification and target selection. The controller intersects semantic dependencies with event footprints, refreshes affected judgments, and updates reachability and selection separately. For fixed deterministic evaluation, planning, and selection, conservative dependency and footprint coverage preserves the decisions of full recomputation. On 240 five-event ProcTHOR sequences with an exact benchmark predicate, MIND reduces mean semantic evaluations from 30.6 to 11.2 while preserving all 1,200 post-event decisions. Frozen-evaluator experiments with Phi-4 and Qwen3-14B also preserve all 1,200 decisions, without improving the evaluators' underlying task accuracy. In 32 closed-loop AI2-THOR episodes using exact-predicate qualification and metadata-derived footprints, MIND matches the final target decision of full recomputation in every episode. Unitree G1 experiments demonstrate target reuse and reselection across room transitions without additional semantic evaluations under MIND, and abstention after a barrier and an object removal at 4 evaluations against 15 to 18. Additional materials are available at https://mind-icra27.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：遵循持久语言指令的机器人必须在其环境变化时，判断哪些已缓存的房间判断仍然有效。我们提出MIND（基于指令条件依赖的维护）框架，该框架无需在每次事件后重新评估每个房间，即可维护目标房间决策。语言模型将每条指令编译为语义限定和目标选择所对应的依赖关系。控制器将语义依赖与事件足迹相交，刷新受影响的判断，并分别更新可达性和目标选择。对于固定的确定性评估、规划与选择，保守的依赖及足迹覆盖范围能够保持完整重计算的决策结果。在240条包含五个事件的ProcTHOR序列实验中，采用精确基准谓词时，MIND将平均语义评估次数从30.6次降至11.2次，同时保留了全部1200个事件后决策。使用Phi-4和Qwen3-14B的冻结评估器实验同样保留了全部1200个决策，且未提升评估器在底层任务上的准确率。在32个闭环AI2-THOR回合中，采用精确谓词限定和基于元数据的足迹信息，MIND在每个回合中均与完整重计算的最终目标决策保持一致。Unitree G1实验表明，在MIND框架下，房间切换时可复用或重新选择目标而无需额外的语义评估；在设置障碍物和移除物体后，模型选择弃权，此时仅需4次评估，而完整重计算需要15至18次。更多材料请见 https://mind-icra27.github.io/。

Authors: Mohamed Abouagour, Junhyun Nam, Wonse Jo, Byung-Cheol Min

Benchmarking 3D Reconstruction for Under-Ice Robotic Perception in Arctic Environments Other

under-ice robotic perception 3D reconstruction structure-from-motion monocular depth estimation Arctic robotics

简要说明：本文提出了一个针对北极冰下环境的视觉三维重建基准，利用MOSAiC真实数据和模拟器合成数据，评估运动恢复结构和单目深度估计方法。

TLDR: This paper presents a benchmark for vision-based 3D reconstruction in under-ice Arctic environments, using real MOSAiC data and synthetic simulator data, and evaluates SfM and monocular depth estimation against sonar ground truth.

Abstract: As the Arctic transitions toward a seasonally ice-free state, capturing the complex morphology of submerged sea ice is crucial for advancing models of ocean-ice-atmosphere heat exchange and monitoring under-ice habitats. Currently, sub-surface ice mapping is predominantly achieved through acoustic sensors such as multibeam sonar. While sonar provides robust large-scale geometry, it lacks spectral and high-resolution textural information required to record fine morphological features - a critical limitation in under-ice environments, where sparse visual features and degraded sensing conditions challenge the capture of detailed structural and optical surface properties. We present a benchmark for vision-based under-ice 3D reconstruction using real-world data from the MOSAiC expedition and synthetic data generated in an Unreal Engine-based underwater robotics simulator. The benchmark evaluates Structure-From-Motion (SfM) and monocular depth estimation, with quantitative comparison enabled through cross-modal registration to upward-looking multibeam sonar.

摘要（中文）：随着北极向季节性无冰状态过渡，捕捉水下海冰的复杂形态对于推进海洋-冰-大气热交换模型及监测冰下栖息地至关重要。目前，水下冰面测绘主要依靠多波束声纳等声学传感器实现。尽管声纳能够提供稳健的大尺度几何信息，但其缺乏记录精细形态特征所需的光谱及高分辨率纹理信息——这在冰下环境中尤为受限，因为该环境中稀疏的视觉特征和退化的感知条件对捕捉详细的结构与光学表面属性构成了挑战。 我们提出了一种基于视觉的冰下三维重建基准，利用来自MOSAiC考察的真实数据及基于虚幻引擎的水下机器人模拟器生成的合成数据。该基准评估了运动恢复结构（SfM）与单目深度估计方法，并通过与向上观测多波束声纳的跨模态配准实现定量比较。

Authors: Klára Orbán, Ashwin Nedungadi, Ana-Ştefania Kogălniceanu, Bianca-Marcela Sava, Bastian Cieply, Raul-Alexandru Simon, Kuderna-Iulian Benţa, Stefan Lüdtke

RingNav: Task-Shaped Circular Memory for Visual Heading Other

visual heading estimation circular memory visual navigation tiny robots efficient inference

简要说明：RingNav 提出了一种任务形状的循环记忆，用于微型机器人上的视觉航向估计，将记忆限制在 S^1 流形上并仅学习图像之间的转向，在 TartanAir 和真实无人机实验中提高了精度和效率。

TLDR: RingNav proposes a task-shaped circular memory for visual heading estimation on tiny robots, constraining memory to the S^1 manifold and learning only turns between images, achieving improved accuracy and efficiency on TartanAir and real drone experiments.

Abstract: Tiny robots have limited computation and memory, yet visual navigation systems often maintain more state than a task requires. We ask whether persistent memory can instead be shaped by the task. We present \textbf{RingNav}, a \(10.6\)k--parameter visual heading estimator that constrains its memory to the circular manifold \(S^1\). RingNav learns only the turn between consecutive images, while heading is composed directly on the circle. On the TartanAir Visual SLAM Challenge, RingNav reduces mean absolute turn error by \(27\%\) and accumulated heading error over $4$ sec by \(15\%\) relative to a similarly sized learned-memory model. The structured update also gives exactly zero turn for identical frames and exact cancellation under sequence reversal. Without fine-tuning, RingNav transfers to real-world drone experiments and continues estimating heading under severe visual degradation. RingNav runs at $27.3$Hz on Raspberry Pi Zero 2W and can be deployed on an ultra-low power GAP8 processor at $33.4$Hz.

摘要（中文）：微型机器人的计算与存储资源有限，然而视觉导航系统所维护的状态往往超出任务实际所需。我们探讨是否能够依据任务需求来塑造持久记忆。为此，我们提出了**RingNav**，一个仅含\(10.6\)k参数的视觉航向估计器，其记忆被限制在圆形流形\(S^1\)上。RingNav仅学习连续图像之间的转角，而航向则直接在圆上进行合成。在TartanAir视觉SLAM挑战赛中，与规模相当的带学习记忆模型相比，RingNav的平均绝对转角误差降低了\(27\%\)，且在\(4\)秒内的累计航向误差减少了\(15\%\)。结构化更新还使得相同帧间的转角精确为零，并在序列反转时实现精确抵消。无需微调，RingNav即可迁移至真实世界的无人机实验中，并在严重的视觉退化条件下持续估计航向。RingNav在Raspberry Pi Zero 2W上以\(27.3\)Hz的频率运行，并可部署于超低功耗的GAP8处理器上，运行频率达\(33.4\)Hz。

Authors: Naitri Rajyaguru, Aryan Tajne, Stephen Jardim, Cornelia Fermuller, Yiannis Aloimonos

Imagining Goals with Geometric Horizon Models for Policy Generalization RLRobot

geometric horizon model goal generalization world models goal-conditioned BC OGBench

简要说明：TD-Aug 从几何视界模型中采样以想象新目标，用于目标条件行为克隆策略，提升 OGBench 任务中的零样本组合泛化能力。

TLDR: TD-Aug samples from a geometric horizon model to imagine novel goals for goal-conditioned BC policies, improving zero-shot compositional generalization in OGBench tasks.

Abstract: Training from offline data has allowed for substantial progress in domains such as robotics, leading to general-purpose policies that can be easily applied zero-shot or efficiently finetuned for downstream tasks. However, these policies can still have poor generalization, both due to the choice of modeling objective and from learning from a static dataset. In this work, we focus on the challenging task of zero-shot goal generalization, where a policy is evaluated on unseen tasks that require combining its existing knowledge (compositional generalization). An avenue for improving a policy's generalization is by generating new experience with world models; however, such generation has proven difficult for longer horizons. Thus, to alleviate this issue, we propose TD-Aug, which samples from a geometric horizon model and allows for directly imagining novel outcomes that can be achieved by composing existing knowledge. We demonstrate that training on these future outcomes as goals for goal-conditioned BC policies significantly improves generalization in stitching-based OGBench tasks.

摘要（中文）：从离线数据训练已在机器人等领域取得了显著进展，催生了通用策略，这些策略能够轻松地以零样本方式应用，或通过微调高效适配下游任务。然而，由于建模目标的选择以及从静态数据集学习的局限性，这些策略的泛化能力仍可能不足。本研究聚焦于零样本目标泛化这一具有挑战性的任务，即策略需在未见任务上通过组合已有知识完成评估（组合泛化）。提升策略泛化能力的一个途径是利用世界模型生成新经验；然而，对于较长视界，这种生成已被证明较为困难。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种名为TD-Aug的方法，该方法从几何视界模型中采样，从而能够直接想象通过组合现有知识可实现的新颖结果。我们证明，在这些未来结果作为目标训练条件为目标的BC策略，显著提升了基于拼接的OGBench任务中的泛化性能。

Authors: Daniel Lawson, Dhruv Sreenivas, Adriana Hugessen, Khimya Khetarpal, Glen Berseth

Towards a Data-Centric Understanding of Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models Other

spatial reasoning multimodal large language models dataset design fine-tuning evaluation

简要说明：这篇综述系统地回顾了以数据为中心的方法，通过微调多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）来提升空间推理能力，对数据集设计、构建和评估进行分类，并指出了未来的研究方向。

TLDR: This survey systematically reviews data-centric methods for fine-tuning multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to improve spatial reasoning, categorizing dataset design, construction, and evaluation, and identifying future research directions.

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been widely applied in embodied agents and robotics for vision tasks. However, MLLMs suffer from limitations in spatial reasoning and perception. Post-training techniques have shown promise for improving these capabilities; yet, there are limited data-driven surveys of such approaches. In this survey, we consider approaches to fine-tuning pretrained MLLMs for spatial reasoning tasks, ranging from supervised to reinforcement learning, with an emphasis on the datasets used. We investigate themes of dataset construction, data modality and annotation, and evaluation of the resulting models. Based on these themes, we categorize research into three groups: dataset design, dataset construction and evaluation. We find four main methods for constructing fixed spatial annotations: rules and templates, LLM prompting, procedural generation, and human-in-the-loop. We also observe substantial variation in evaluation approaches, including different scoring methods, tolerance metrics, and benchmark types. Finally, we identify opportunities for future research in unified dynamic annotation, efficient spatial reasoning, standardization of evaluation, expanded spatial range, and human-centered spatial interactions.

摘要（中文）：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）已广泛应用于具身智能体和机器人领域的视觉任务中。然而，MLLMs在空间推理和感知方面存在局限性。后训练技术已显示出提升这些能力的潜力；然而，目前对此类方法的数据驱动综述较为有限。本综述考察了针对空间推理任务对预训练MLLMs进行微调的方法，涵盖从监督学习到强化学习的各类技术，并重点关注所用数据集。我们探讨了数据集构建、数据模态与标注以及所得模型评估等主题。基于这些主题，我们将研究分为三类：数据集设计、数据集构建和评估。我们发现构建固定空间标注主要有四种方法：规则与模板、大语言模型提示、程序化生成以及人在回路。同时，我们观察到评估方法存在显著差异，包括不同的评分方式、容差指标和基准类型。最后，我们指出了未来研究的机会，包括统一动态标注、高效空间推理、评估标准化、空间范围扩展以及以人为中心的空间交互。

Authors: Mahdieh Mallahnezhad, Masoud Jafaripour, Mohamadali Tofigh, Sheila Schoepp, Osmar R. Zaiane

SPECTRA-VLA: Base-Fine Hyperspectral Token Transfer at Frozen Vision-Language-Action Interfaces VLA

hyperspectral imaging token transfer frozen VLA continuous residual spectral recovery

简要说明：SPECTRA-VLA 提出一种方法，通过在冻结的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型的token中注入学习到的连续残差，使其适应高光谱输入，在不重训练VLA模型的情况下提高分类和光谱恢复性能。

TLDR: SPECTRA-VLA introduces a method to adapt vision-language-action (VLA) models to hyperspectral input by injecting learned continuous residuals into frozen VLA tokens, improving classification and spectral recovery without retraining the VLA model.

Abstract: Hyperspectral imaging distinguishes RGB-similar objects, but a pretrained vision-language-action model needs a state its frozen decoder can use. SPECTRA-VLA provides a native-width spectral upgrade without retraining the visual encoder or action decoder. A learned continuous residual enriches each target token through its own normalized false-color reference; projection, norm control and validation-calibrated injection regulate the change. Across 86 held-out acquisitions, category balanced accuracy rises from 0.812 to 0.883. With identical residuals and scale, own-token addition improves reuse of an external category-derived probe on frozen decoder logits: 0.701 versus 0.590 with pooled replacement, at similar image-disjoint recognition. Five grouped tests covering the same 86 acquisitions recover within-category spectral shape with $R^2=0.802/0.337$ from continuous and posterior-code states. Category-matched spectral swaps further show that own-token composition approximately doubles the target-specific recovery increment after frozen decoding. Spectral enrichment and receiving-token preservation thus work together at the pretrained interface.

摘要（中文）：高光谱成像能够区分RGB相似物体，但预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型需要一种其冻结解码器可用的状态。SPECTRA-VLA提供了一种原生宽度的光谱升级方法，无需重新训练视觉编码器或动作解码器。通过学习得到的连续残差，每个目标标记通过其自身的归一化假彩色参考得到增强；投影、范数控制和验证校准注入共同调节这一变化。在86个保留采集数据上，类别平衡准确率从0.812提升至0.883。在相同的残差和尺度条件下，自标记加法提升了外部类别派生探针在冻结解码器logits上的复用效果：0.701对比池化替换的0.590，且图像不相交识别性能相近。覆盖相同86个采集数据的五组分组测试，从连续状态和后验编码状态中恢复类别内光谱形状，$R^2$分别为0.802和0.337。类别匹配的光谱交换进一步表明，自标记组合在冻结解码后使目标特定恢复增量大约翻倍。因此，光谱增强与接收标记保留在预训练接口上协同发挥作用。

Authors: Chih-Chung Hsu

Comprehensive Comparisons of Reinforcement Learning Algorithms in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

reinforcement learning autonomous driving decision-making unsignalized intersection algorithm comparison

简要说明：本文比较了四种强化学习算法在无信号交叉口的自动驾驶决策中的应用，从最优性、安全性、训练稳定性和成本方面进行评估，并给出方法选择建议。

TLDR: This paper compares four reinforcement learning algorithms for autonomous vehicle decision-making at an unsignalized intersection, evaluating them on optimality, safety, training stability, and cost, and providing method selection suggestions.

Abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive comparison of four representative reinforcement learning (RL) methods in autonomous vehicle (AV) decision-making, including: Fitted Value Iteration (FVI), Rollout Classification Policy Iteration (RCPI), Deep Q-Network (DQN), and a discrete-action adaptation of Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (D-DDPG). The four methods are applied to the same AV decision-making problem at an unsignalized intersection and are compared in terms of optimality and safety, training stability, and training and decision cost. RCPI is the closest to a reference solution and has the most stable training process. However, it is the least data-efficient. D-DDPG reaches the second-smallest gap to a reference solution with the highest data efficiency, but has the least training stability. DQN is the most stable model-free method but has the highest collision rate. FVI achieves a lower collision rate than DQN, but is less data-efficient and less stable. Based on these results, we provide suggestions for selecting a method according to whether a model is available, the budget for training, and whether stable training is required.

摘要（中文）：本文对四种具有代表性的强化学习（RL）方法在自动驾驶车辆（AV）决策中的应用进行了全面比较，包括：拟合值迭代（FVI）、滚动分类策略迭代（RCPI）、深度Q网络（DQN）以及离散动作适应的深度确定性策略梯度（D-DDPG）。将这四种方法应用于无信号交叉口的同一自动驾驶决策问题，并从最优性和安全性、训练稳定性及训练与决策成本等方面进行比较。RCPI最接近参考解，且训练过程最为稳定，但其数据效率最低。D-DDPG与参考解的差距位居第二小，数据效率最高，但训练稳定性最差。DQN是最稳定的无模型方法，但其碰撞率最高。FVI的碰撞率低于DQN，但数据效率和稳定性较差。基于这些结果，我们根据是否拥有模型、训练预算以及是否需要稳定训练，为方法选择提供了建议。
